title: Business Developer
description:
Establecer relaciones con profesionales de la construcción para promover las ventas de Herramientas Manuales y Accesorios Bosch como una solución para la construcción.
Impulsar la colocación de accesorios para herramientas eléctricas y herramientas manuales en nuevos canales de distribución mediante la prospección, la maximización de oportunidades de venta a través de programas de marketing y la conversión de clientes de la competencia.
Enfocarse en iniciativas estratégicas clave en el comercio tradicional y la distribución industrial mediante la gestión de categorías (category management) y la demostración de características y beneficios de productos innovadores clave.
Investigar e identificar clientes potenciales (targets) de alto valor.
Tener una mentalidad de "cazador" (hunter) y un fuerte deseo de generar nuevos negocios incrementales.
Comprensión de las necesidades del usuario y del producto relevante para las soluciones de construcción.
Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los Gerentes de Ventas y Representantes de Ventas de la zona respectiva para desarrollar una estrategia que impulse las ventas.
Comunicación efectiva y eficiente con la organización de ventas mediante actualizaciones semanales y conferencias telefónicas mensuales del equipo.
Brindar capacitación sobre el conocimiento del producto a la nueva distribución según sea necesario.
Impulsar la venta final (sell-through) de la distribución mediante la identificación de usuarios finales estratégicos clave, realizando demostraciones en las obras e iniciativas de capacitación.
Es posible que se requiera asistir a ferias comerciales o eventos de clientes en fines de semana ocasionales, así como a sesiones de capacitación o reuniones de ventas.
Enfocarse en el desarrollo del negocio de Herramientas Manuales y Accesorios, con disponibilidad para viajar eventualmente dentro de México para atender oportunidades identificadas en otras zonas.
Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en ventas y/o desarrollo de negocios, o una combinación equivalente de educación y experiencia en la venta de Herramientas Eléctricas, Herramientas Manuales y Accesorios en el comercio tradicional, la distribución industrial y la industria ferretera.
Título profesional o diploma en Ventas y Marketing, Administración, Gestión de la Construcción o una disciplina relacionada.
Capacidad para trabajar con equipos internos y la dirección ejecutiva, así como con clientes externos, para maximizar el beneficio mutuo.
Capacidad para leer, analizar, interpretar y responder de manera efectiva a las necesidades de las cuentas y de los usuarios.
Capacidad para realizar presentaciones efectivas y persuasivas sobre diversos temas ante clientes y la dirección.
Conocimiento de la industria de Herramientas Eléctricas, Herramientas Manuales y Accesorios, así como del sector de la construcción en México.
Conocimiento de técnicas de edificación y construcción, seguridad en la obra y protocolo en zonas de trabajo.
Conocimiento de la Distribución Tradicional e Industrial en México.
Sólidas habilidades de venta e interpersonales.
Habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita fuertes y efectivas (el dominio del idioma francés es una ventaja).
Sólidas habilidades financieras, matemáticas y de organización.
Territorio: Ciudad de México, Estado de México e Hidalgo. Disponibilidad para viajar eventualmente por todo México.
Por elección propia, estamos comprometidos con una fuerza laboral diversa y somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Robert Bosch recibe con agrado y fomenta las solicitudes de empleo de personas con discapacidad. Se ofrecen adaptaciones y ajustes razonables bajo petición para los candidatos que participen en el proceso de selección.

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA SÊNIOR (BACK-END)
description:
## Como será o seu dia a dia
• Evoluir o sistema de faturamento de uma distribuidora, em .NET Framework 4.8 e SQL Server.
• Usar ferramentas de IA, dentro da metodologia Traction da Quality Digital, para ler o código e as stored procedures de faturamento e extrair as regras de negócio.
• Implementar regras de cadastro, classificação fiscal, documento único, refaturamento e integração com o SAP.
• Garantir a cada entrega que o cálculo atual do faturamento continue correto, com regressão automatizada.
• Trabalhar com o PO da Quality Digital e com as áreas de negócio e TI do cliente.
• Atuar como referência técnica do time de desenvolvimento.
• Acompanhar demandas e entregas no Azure DevOps, em sprints de 15 dias.
## Responsabilidades
• Fazer a engenharia reversa do código e das stored procedures de faturamento e documentar o sistema.
• Montar a base de regressão: executar a suíte de testes automatizados existente e criar os novos testes da NFGás.
• Implementar as validações de cadastro.
• Implementar refaturamento com referência ao documento anterior, devolução, ajuste e parcelamento.
• Desenvolver a validação em lote da base de clientes, preparada para crescimento de volume, e a validação pré-faturamento.
• Desenvolver a integração com o SAP S/4HANA via contrato JSON versionado.
• Desenvolver o adapter para o serviço externo de validação.
• Construir as telas de monitor de integrações, painel de higienização, inconsistências e parametrização com trilha de auditoria.
• Preparar os scripts de corte e a chave de ativação (feature flag) da virada e atuar no hypercare.
• Revisar criticamente todo código gerado por IA antes de abrir o PR.
• Apoiar e orientar tecnicamente os demais desenvolvedores do time.
## O que buscamos?
Um profissional com olhar para melhorias e entregas de valor.
## Como será o seu dia a dia:
• Terá a visão do projeto como um todo e apoiará o time no processo de quebra das tarefas e entendimento das mesmas, visando uma melhor eficiência na entrega;
• Irá se certificar de que a solução que está sendo construída atenderá as necessidades dos clientes e contém a aplicação de boas práticas;
• Acompanhar os processos de roll-out dos projetos e apoiar o time na identificação e solução de problemas, e em casos críticos conduzir o time;
• Responsável por mentorar sobre práticas, ferramentas e conceitos de testes, apoiará o time no refactor de testes;
• Atuar na identificação e correção de falhas de segurança ou gerar documentação mapeando o cenário identificado;
• Conhecer modelos e práticas de arquitetura,quando necessárioapoiar o time de arquitetura na validação do desenho de soluções e traduzir as arquiteturas em solução no processo de desenvolvimento;
• Acompanhar as cerimônias do time se há algum impedimento ou problema e apoiar na construção do plano de ação;
• Conhecer as métricas que o time usa e analisá-las, sugerindo mudanças e usando-as para processos de planejamento e alinhamentos;
• Documentar e demonstrar soluções, desenvolvendo documentação, fluxogramas, layouts, diagramas, gráficos e código claro.
Obrigatórios
• Experiência de 6 anos ou mais com C# e .NET Framework 4.x, incluindo manutenção e evolução de sistemas legados.
• SQL Server com T-SQL avançado: stored procedures complexas, transações, processamento em lote e otimização de consultas.
• Desenvolvimento web fullstack em (WebForms ou MVC), HTML e JavaScript.
• Integração REST/JSON com contratos versionados, idempotência, retentativas e rastreabilidade de chamadas.
• Testes automatizados (MSTest, NUnit ou xUnit) e refatoração segura de código legado protegida por testes.
• Capacidade de ler e entender código legado sem documentação.
• Uso prático de ferramentas de IA no desenvolvimento (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code ou similares), com senso crítico para revisar e corrigir o que a IA produz.
• Git e Azure DevOps (boards, repos e pipelines).
Desejável
• Experiência com sistemas de faturamento ou com documentos fiscais eletrônicos (NF-e, NF3e, NFCom).
• Experiência com integração entre sistemas satélites e SAP S/4HANA.
• Conhecimento do domínio de distribuição de gás, energia ou outras utilities.
• Experiência com feature flags e estratégias de virada com reversão por parâmetro.
• Experiência com engenharia reversa de regras de negócio em stored procedures.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Java Especialista
Software Engineer-2
description:
## About the Team/Role
We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer II to join our Risk Engineering team. This is a high-bar engineering role for someone with a strong Computer Science foundation, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently design and deliver production software end to end.
Risk Engineering builds business-critical platforms supporting credit, fraud, financial crimes, and collections. Our technology includes Node.js/TypeScript, AWS, Kafka, microservices etc., with both synchronous and asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
We are looking for engineers who understand the fundamentals behind the technologies they use, can reason through complex problems, make sound technical decisions, and take ownership from problem definition through production support.
## How you’ll make an impact
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production software across the full lifecycle.
• Independently own medium-to-high complexity technical problems and communicate technical decisions and tradeoffs.
• AI-Assisted Engineering
• Use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, solution quality, and problem-solving.
• Apply thoughtful prompt engineering, providing appropriate context, constraints, and requirements.
• Use AI to assist with design exploration, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code analysis.
• Critically evaluate AI-generated output and modify, improve, or reject it when necessary.
• Maintain ownership of the final design and implementation rather than blindly accepting generated code.
• Experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) or similar AI-assisted development practices is a strong plus.
• Design scalable microservices and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript, AWS, Kafka, and related technologies.
• Build and support both synchronous and asynchronous/event-driven systems.
• Apply strong Computer Science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, complexity, concurrency, data modeling, and software design to solve technical problems.
• Develop clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested software.
• Contribute to CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and production reliability.
• Collaborate closely with teammates and cross-functional partners to understand problems and deliver effective solutions.
• Communicate proactively: raise risks and issues early, communicate blockers as they arise, and keep teammates informed rather than waiting for scheduled meetings or standups.
• Work independently while recognizing when to seek help, ask questions, or involve others. Know when to keep digging and when collaboration will lead to a better outcome.
• Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews; provide mentorship and constructive feedback to other engineers.
Strong Computer Science Foundation
Candidates should be comfortable discussing and applying:
• Data structures and algorithms
• Algorithmic complexity and performance
• Software design principles and patterns
• Object-oriented and/or functional programming
• Concurrency and asynchronous programming
• Database and data modeling fundamentals
• Networking, APIs, and distributed systems
• Testing and software quality
• We value engineers who understand why a solution works, not simply how to implement it using a particular framework.
End-to-End Engineering & Technical Judgment
Strong candidates can take a problem through:
Understand → Design → Implement → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Troubleshoot → Improve
They should be comfortable working independently, evaluating alternatives and tradeoffs, and knowing when to seek collaboration or guidance.
Communication & Collaboration
Strong engineers communicate throughout the work, not only when asked or during scheduled meetings. We value engineers who:
• Work effectively as part of a team and actively share information.
• Ask questions and seek help when they are stuck rather than spending excessive time blocked.
• Raise risks, issues, and concerns early, giving the team an opportunity to respond.
• Communicate blockers and changes in status as they happen rather than waiting for standup.
• Know when to work independently and when collaboration will produce a better outcome.
• Give and receive constructive feedback.
• Clearly communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
## Experience you’ll bring
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• Strong Computer Science fundamentals and demonstrated experience designing and developing production software end to end.
• Experience with APIs, automated testing, cloud applications, and CI/CD.
• Experience with microservices, distributed systems, or event-driven architectures.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
What Success Looks Like
You are a strong, independent engineer who can solve complex problems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and deliver reliable production software. You understand the fundamentals behind your technology choices, take ownership of outcomes, and contribute to the technical growth of the team.
You communicate proactively, collaborate effectively, and know when to work through a problem independently versus when to involve others. You raise issues early and keep your team informed as work progresses.
You use AI to amplify your engineering capabilities, not replace your judgment. You know how to provide useful context, evaluate AI-generated solutions, and change or replace them when they are not the right answer.
Preferred Qualifications
• Node.js and TypeScript
• AWS
• Kafka or similar messaging platforms
• Asynchronous/event-driven architectures
• PostgreSQL, Redis, Snowflake, or similar technologies
• Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools
• Production observability and operational practices

Week 2: Work Wednesdaythrough Saturday (4 consecutive days)
The schedule rotates on a bi-weekly basis.

title: Salesforce Data Analyst II
description:
## Position Summary
The Data Analyst II keeps data accurate, complete, and on time for a large enterprise Salesforce platform that exchanges records with multiple external partners. These positions process and validate incoming data feeds, correct data issues at the source, and produce the counts and reports that leadership relies on. Analysts must already be working with Salesforce data.
## Responsibilities
• Receive, validate, and load external partner data feeds against the data dictionary, and resolve rejected or inconsistent records.
• Profile data, identify quality issues, trace root causes, and carry corrections through to closure.
• Produce point-in-time counts, lists, and recurring reports on a fixed calendar.
• Query and update Salesforce data using SOQL, reports, and Data Loader, following the approved request process.
• Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau or CRM Analytics.
• Support data validation and reconciliation for the Education Cloud migration.
• Communicate data issues and resolutions to external partners in the language of the data dictionary.
• Estimate work in hours, log time against assigned Jira tickets, and document procedures in Confluence.
## Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
• 3+ years of data analysis experience.
• Hands-on experience with Salesforce data within the last 12 months: SOQL, reports, and Data Loader.
• Advanced SQL and Excel.
• Experience validating and reconciling data exchanged between organizations.
• Experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or a comparable reporting tool.
• Active Salesforce Trailblazer account with a public profile.
• U.S. citizenship.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated federal background investigation. A security clearance is not required.
• Ability to handle and safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information.
## Required Salesforce Certifications
The certification requirement must be current and verifiable:
• Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.
Candidates must list their certifications on their resumes and provide their Trailblazer profile URL. Required certifications will be verified before interviews are scheduled.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud or EDA data.
• Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant or Salesforce Certified Tableau Data Analyst.
• Python for data validation and automation.
• Experience supporting federal government technology programs.
• Current favorably adjudicated federal background investigation.
Location: Remote.
The selected candidate must be currently located in, or willing to relocate to, a state supported by Tripoint Solutions corporate offices: AL, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD, MN, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, or VA.(No relocation assistance provided)
## Clearance Requirements:
U.S. Citizenship is required.
A favorably adjudicated (approved) National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) or equivalent (Tier 1 Investigation) or ability to obtain a government clearance.
## About Tripoint Solutions
We are technology innovators, partnered with state-of-the-art providers, such as AWS, ServiceNow, and UiPath, to drive digital transformation in the federal space. TPS teams are bringing automation and data science into areas of the government that are crying out for fresh tech—making positive impacts felt by tens of thousands of users, countless citizens, and all six branches of the military each day. Our Agile teams are responsible for envisioning, launching, and operating the massive data systems and analytics platforms used to manage $14.5B in government procurements and $200B in military real estate assets globally. At TPS, we apply the power of cloud technologies to help the government think smarter and function better—for everyone.
## TPS Company Values
• We value and respect each employee's dedicated work and unique contributions as they directly impact who we are and what we do.
• Your talent and innovative thinking bring leading-edge solutions to our customers.
• Our success is driven by the dedication of our employees.
• Employee-generated solutions have sustained our continued success and customer satisfaction
## Benefit Offerings
Tripoint Solutions builds flexibility into health benefit plan choices, covers most of the monthly premiums, and helps employees build a career with impact through our generous professional development program.
## We offer all full-time employees:
• Medical, Dental, Vision benefits with a national provider network
• Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts (FSA & HSA)
• Company-paid Life and Disability insurance including Short-Term, Long-Term, and Accidental
• Supplemental Insurance
• Paid time off (PTO)
• 11 paid holidays
• 401(k) Retirement Plan
• Professional Development Reimbursement Program to pursue undergraduate, graduate, training, and certifications
• Monthly transportation, parking, and cell phone service reimbursement

title: Salesforce Software Developer II
description:
## Position Summary
The Software Developer II designs, builds, tests, and supports enterprise Salesforce solutions on a large enterprise Salesforce platform that serves thousands of users and is scaling significantly over the next year. The developer works in an Agile delivery environment with frequent production releases and contributes to the transition from Salesforce Education Data Architecture (EDA) to Salesforce Education Cloud. This is a hands-on development position requiring immediate proficiency in Salesforce development.
## Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and custom objects.
• Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, external partner data feeds, a learning management system, MuleSoft, and AWS GovCloud services using REST and SOAP APIs, platform events, and middleware.
• Support the Education Cloud migration by analyzing existing customizations, implementing approved configurations, supporting Person Account conversion and data validation, and testing integrations against the new data model.
• Configure, develop, and test approved Agentforce capabilities, actions, and integrations within established governance and security requirements.
• Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, demonstrations, and retrospectives. Provide accurate development estimates and time reporting against assigned Jira tickets.
• Deliver well-tested code that meets documented acceptance criteria, passes established quality checks, and minimizes defects introduced into production.
• Apply secure coding practices and implement assigned controls consistent with applicable federal security, privacy, and Section 508 accessibility requirements. Remediate assigned vulnerabilities within established timelines.
• Document designs, technical decisions, and configuration changes in Jira and Confluence. Support production incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
## Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
• Minimum of four years of professional software development experience.
• Current hands-on Salesforce development experience using Apex and Lightning Web Components in a production organization within the last 12 months.
• Experience developing on Salesforce Education Data Architecture or Education Cloud.
• Experience implementing Salesforce integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, platform events, or middleware such as MuleSoft.
• Experience with Git-based source control, unit testing, debugging, and deployments across development, testing, and production environments.
• Active Salesforce Trailblazer account with a public profile.
• U.S. citizenship.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated federal background investigation. A security clearance is not required.
• Ability to handle and safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information.
## Required Salesforce Certifications
All certification requirements must be current and verifiable:
• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (formerly Platform Developer I).
• One of: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II, Platform Administrator, or Platform App Builder.
• Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist.
Candidates must list their certifications on their resumes and provide their Trailblazer profile URL. Required certifications will be verified before interviews are scheduled.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience integrating Salesforce with a learning management system, including data exchange between the two.
• Salesforce Certified Education Cloud Consultant certification.
• Experience supporting Salesforce data model migrations, including Person Accounts.
• Experience with MuleSoft, AWS GovCloud, Experience Cloud, or Tableau.
• Experience implementing Agentforce solutions in a production environment.
• Experience supporting federal government technology programs.

description:
About Vcheck
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
About the role
We are looking for an AI Architect to design, build, and operate the AI systems that power Vcheck’s technology transformation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you are expected to ship systems, not just design them. You will own the architecture of our agentic AI capabilities, from model selection and prompt engineering to agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software integration, while leading a small AI and automation team and setting the technical standard for how AI is embedded across the business. This is not an AI research role or an innovation lab experiment, so success means production AI systems that work, scale, and help Vcheck move faster, spend less, and deliver higher quality than our competitors. This is a remote role based in the US, with candidates in the NYC metro area preferred.
What you'll be doing
• Design and implement multi-agent AI architectures for business critical workflows, including agentic orchestration systems, AI augmented software delivery pipelines, and intelligent automation across operations and service delivery.
• Evaluate and select AI models, frameworks, and tooling (LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, orchestration layers) for each use case, balancing capability, latency, cost, and reliability.
• Own the architecture and evolution of internal AI frameworks, including reusable prompt libraries, agent pipelines, and workflow automation tooling that multiply the team’s capacity across initiatives.
• Define and implement integration patterns that connect AI systems to Vcheck’s enterprise software stack (ERP, CRM, ticketing, data platforms) through APIs, webhooks, and protocol layers.
• Manage and develop a small AI and automation team, and set engineering standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and deployment.
• Design and maintain observability systems that track AI adoption, output quality, accuracy, cost, and ROI, and keep automated outputs at 99%+ accuracy through reflection and review loops.
• Implement AI governance standards, including model evaluation, output validation, audit trails, data residency, and compliance with Vcheck’s security and regulatory requirements.
• Upskill engineering and operations teams on AI implementation best practices, agentic design patterns, and prompt engineering so AI adoption scales beyond the AI team.
• Other duties as assigned
About you
Key requirements:
We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
• 8+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with the last 3+ years focused substantially on AI/ML systems in production.
• Deep hands on experience building with LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine tuning tradeoffs, context window management, and tool and function calling.
• Experience designing and deploying multi-agent AI systems in production, including orchestration, task delegation, error handling, and observability.
• Proficiency in Python (preferred) or an equivalent language, with the ability to read and work across production codebases in multiple languages.
• Solid cloud infrastructure experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including deployment, scaling, cost management, and security.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to document architecture decisions clearly enough that other engineers can build on them without your involvement.
• Demonstrated ability to lead small technical teams and set engineering standards.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Teams.
• Experience with AI native development tools and workflows such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Cursor is preferred.
• Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), embedding pipelines, and semantic search architectures is valued.
• Background integrating AI systems with enterprise software through APIs, webhooks, and protocol layers (MCP, REST, GraphQL) is preferred.
• Experience with AI governance, including model evaluation, output validation, audit trails, and data residency constraints in enterprise environments, is valued.
• Prior experience in a B2B technology enabled services company, a SaaS environment, or due diligence and background screening is a plus.

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.
We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. title: AI Fabric Architect
description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.
As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.
About this role
You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.
What you will do:
Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric
Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many
Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables)
Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live
Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic
Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow
Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec
Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents
Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you
Qualifications:
7+ years in data center or HPC networking, including direct responsibility for production GPU cluster fabrics
A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators
Deep expertise in InfiniBand (NDR/XDR, UFM, subnet management) and/or RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet
Strong command of rail-optimized and Clos/fat-tree designs, BGP/ECMP, and EVPN/VXLAN
A clear understanding of how fabric design and tuning affect collective communication and real workload performance
Comfortable automating with Python, Ansible, or similar
Strong Linux skills and the ability to debug across the boundary between host, NIC, and fabric
Sound judgment on tradeoffs between cost, performance, reliability, and time to deploy
NVIDIA Quantum/Spectrum-X, ConnectX-7/8, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and/or Broadcom Tomahawk 5-class Ethernet
400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking
Nice to have:
Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler AI infrastructure team, NVIDIA networking, or an AI factory integrator
Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design
Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks
Experience building out multiple sites in parallel or on aggressive timelines
Willingness to travel frequently to data center sites, especially during build-outs

title: Backend Software Developer
description:
## Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact
Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.
Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.
Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.
## Jouw rol
Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.
Wat je zal gaan doen:
Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).
Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).
Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.
Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.
Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.
## Wie ben jij?
We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.
Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.
## Wat bieden wij jou?
De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.
Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.
Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).
Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.
Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.
Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.
Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.
Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.
Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.
De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.
Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.
## Over Dawn Technology
We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.
Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.
## Solliciteren
Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.
Have a great day. Dawn Technology.
We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.
Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Software Engineer (PDLC Tooling + Automation)
description:
At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.
We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!
## The Role
As a Software Engineer on Bloomerang's PDLC Operations team, you will build the internal integrations and automations that connect how we build product with the teams who bring it to customers. With our AI-driven product development lifecycle, we ship faster than ever, and the handoffs to Marketing, Enablement, Sales, and our Customer teams have to keep up. Your job is to build the product knowledge layer that gives those teams the context and content they need, when they need it.
You'll report to the Sr. Manager, PDLC Operations, who sets the direction for our PDLC systems, and you'll turn that direction into working tools quickly. You'll build a version, put it in front of users, keep what works, and throw out what doesn't.
## What You Will Do
• Build the capture and classification steps that take content from Jira, GitHub, Notion, Figma, Pendo, and our data platforms such as BigQuery and Databricks, and promote only what partner teams need
• Design and maintain a product knowledge repository with typed, sourced, and versioned content that keeps verified facts, decisions, ideas, and internal-only detail apart
• Design and build role-scoped delivery through our internal AI harness, so Marketing, Sales, Enablement, and Customer teams get launch messaging, battlecards, help content, and training from verified sources, including inside the tools they already use, such as Salesforce, Gainsight, and Intercom
• Automate repetitive PDLC work, such as go-live checklists, release notifications triggered by deploys and feature flag changes, and status roll-ups, so program and product managers can spend their time on decisions instead of coordination
• Prototype several approaches quickly, test them with the people who will use them, and iterate or discard based on what you learn
• Extend and improve our internal apps and dashboards built on tools such as Replit, including portfolio and capacity planning and delivery health metrics

## About The Role
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (mid level, 5 to 8 years of experience) based in Europe to build and scale the infrastructure that takes machine learning models from notebook to production. You will own the MLOps foundation, automate the model lifecycle, integrate streaming data pipelines and bring agentic capabilities into our ML systems. This is a hands on role for someone who cares as much about reliability and observability as about model performance. You will join the Data, AI and ML team and work closely with data science, platform and product teams.
## Your Contribution Will Be
• MLOps framework: design, build and maintain the MLOps platform (experiment tracking, model registry, versioning and reproducible training pipelines); establish CI/CD practices for ML with automated testing, validation gates and promotion workflows from dev to production; define standards and tooling for feature stores, model artifacts and environment reproducibility across teams.
• ML productionizing: take models from research or prototype stage to robust, scalable production services; build low latency, high availability serving infrastructure (batch, online and real time inference); implement monitoring for model performance, data drift and concept drift, with clear alerting and rollback paths; partner with data science teams to harden models for production constraints (latency, cost, scale).
• Automation of ML models: automate retraining, evaluation and deployment pipelines to reduce manual intervention; build self healing and auto rollback mechanisms triggered by performance or drift thresholds; create tooling that lets ML practitioners ship models without needing deep infra expertise.
• Streaming integration: integrate ML models with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink) for real time feature computation and inference; design low latency feature pipelines that bridge batch and streaming data sources; ensure consistency between offline (training) and online (serving) feature computation.
• Agentic integration for ML: design and integrate agentic workflows (LLM based agents, tool calling pipelines) alongside traditional ML models; build the observability, guardrails and evaluation frameworks needed to run agentic systems reliably in production; explore how agents can automate parts of the ML lifecycle itself (monitoring, triage, retraining decisions).
## Minimum Qualifications
• 5 to 8 years of experience in ML engineering, MLOps or backend infrastructure with ML systems in production.
• Strong software engineering fundamentals; comfortable owning services end to end.
• Experience with model serving frameworks (Seldon, KServe, BentoML, TorchServe or similar) and orchestration tools (Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow or similar).
• Hands on experience with streaming systems (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink or similar).

• Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) for ML or distributed systems.
• Strong communication skills and comfort working cross functionally with data science, platform and product teams.
• Fluent English.
• Based in Europe.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to LLM and agent frameworks and evaluation practices.
• Experience in a regulated or high throughput domain (fintech, payments, healthcare).
• Contributions to open source MLOps or agentic tooling.
• Experience with cloud ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks).

title: Data Scientist
description:
## ⌘Role Overview
The Data Scientist is the first hire on the team whose job is to put machine learning into production, not just into a notebook. You'll build models that power product and other live flows sometimes surfaced to users in real time, not just reported on in a dashboard a week later.
The first flagship project is about personalization across the user journey: a model that decides, per user, what offer to show, wired directly into the product and lifecycle experience rather than sitting in a warehouse table. From there, you'll extend the same muscle: model → API → product surface to other high-leverage moments in the user journey.
You'll work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering and Lifecycle marketing to ship models as features, not as reports. This is also a foundational role for the team's infrastructure: most of what Data does today is batch (dbt, Lightdash, BigQuery); you'll help establish our first real-time low-latency serving patterns on GCP and work closely with engineering on this.
## ⌘Key Responsibilities
## 1. Production ML Development
• Build, validate, and ship ML models (propensity, pricing/discount optimization, personalization, churn/LTV) that go live in the product, not just proof-of-concept notebooks.
• Own the full lifecycle: problem framing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining.
• Write production-grade code (tested, versioned, reviewed) — you'll be shipping alongside Engineering, held to their bar.
2. Personalization across the journey: from paywall to lifecycle
• Design and ship the personalized discounting model: who gets what offer, and why, served at the moment of the paywall decision.
• Partner with product on machine learning experiment design (A/B, holdouts) to prove causal lift of the models, not just correlation.
• Build the measurement framework so pricing/discount decisions are defensible to finance and leadership.
## 3. ML Infrastructure & MLOps (GCP)
• Stand up our first low-latency model serving pattern on GCP (e.g., Vertex AI endpoints, Cloud Run, or equivalent)
• Define the feature pipeline pattern: what's precomputed in BigQuery/dbt vs. what needs to be fresh/real-time via Pub/Sub or similar.
• Set up model monitoring: drift, staleness, prediction quality so a live model doesn't silently degrade.
## 4. Product & Engineering Partnership
• Sit close to Product and Engineering, not just Data this role is measured by what ships to actual users, not just notebooks
• Translate a product problem ("how might we reactive lapsed payers") into a modeling problem, and a model output into an API contract Engineering can build against.
• Document handoffs clearly enough that Engineering can own the serving layer long-term without you as a bottleneck.
## 5. Experimentation & Causal Inference
• Design uplift/causal models where "who responds to a discount" matters more than "who churns" .
• Run and interpret experiments that isolate the model's actual incremental impact on revenue/retention.
• Design the experimentation program for improving data science and machine learning models with the same rigour we use across our already ongoing experimentation programs
## ⌘Expected Outcomes
Personalized discounting model live in production, serving real paywall decisions to real users: shipped end-to-end, not a prototype sitting in staging.
A documented, reusable low-latency serving pattern established on GCP (Vertex AI endpoints or Cloud Run) — the next model doesn't require rebuilding this from scratch.
Proven incremental lift on a core business metric (paywall conversion, discount margin efficiency, or lapsed-payer reactivation — pick the one you want as the flagship KPI), demonstrated through a controlled experiment, not just before/after comparison.
Model monitoring in place — drift and staleness alerts mean the team knows within days, not months, if a live model silently degrades.
A repeatable model-to-production playbook that others in the team can follow
## ⌘Skills & Competencies
## Must have (hard skills)
• Strong Python for data science and ML (scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM; PyTorch or TensorFlow a plus if deep learning is relevant to future use cases).
• Proven track record shipping models to production, not just modeling in a notebook. Can talk through at least one model that served live traffic.
• Hands-on experience with a cloud ML platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML, Cloud Run/Functions) or fast ability to translate equivalent AWS/Azure experience.
• Solid SQL; comfortable working against a dbt/BigQuery warehouse.
• Software engineering fundamentals: git, code review, testing, CI/CD: You'll be shipping code Engineering has to trust.
• Causal inference / uplift modelling or applied experimentation experience: pricing and discounting need "what if we hadn't," not just "who churns."
## Nice to have
• Experience with streaming/event pipelines (Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Kafka): useful as we move off pure batch.
• Experience with pricing, discounting, personalization specifically.
• Familiarity with feature stores or the DIY equivalent (versioned feature pipelines).
• Multi-armed bandits or reinforcement learning for pricing/personalization.
• Startup experience: comfortable being the first person to build something rather than joining an existing ML platform team.
## Soft skills
• Genuinely energised by "does this move the metric," not just "is this model accurate."
• Can hold their own in a room with Engineering and with Business: Speaks commercial as well as the language of engineering
• Explains modeling tradeoffs in plain business terms to Product/leadership without dumbing it down or using too much jargon
• Comfortable owning ambiguity — this role is defining the pattern, not following one.
⌘Required experience
• 4–7 years in a data scientist / ML engineer role, with at least one model you personally took from prototype to live production serving real users or real traffic.
• Quantitative background (CS, stats, engineering or equivalent hands-on experience).
• B2C, subscription, or marketplace experience is a strong plus
• Fluent English.
⌘Recruitment process
Introduction Call - 30min with Talent Acquisition Manager
Business Interview - 30min with VP Data
Case Study - Async assessment
Panel Interview - Case study Q&A
Final interview - Interview with Product Manager

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. You will work across Linux systems, servers, compute clusters, and supporting infrastructure, partnering with engineering teams to identify issues, resolve failures, and prevent recurring problems.
This role is focused on infrastructure reliability and operational execution, with opportunities to improve monitoring, automation, troubleshooting, and recovery practices as our infrastructure scales.
This role isremote, based out of North America.
We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.
## Who You Are
• Experienced in SRE, infrastructure operations, systems administration, production support, or a related technical operations role.
• Comfortable working with Linux systems and server infrastructure, with strong troubleshooting skills and a methodical approach to investigating unfamiliar issues.
• Familiar with monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and system health metrics, with the ability to distinguish actionable incidents from routine fluctuations.
• Organized and detail-oriented, with experience maintaining technical documentation, operational procedures, and troubleshooting runbooks.
• A clear communicator and collaborative problem-solver who takes ownership of issues, follows through on escalations, and looks for ways to improve reliability.
## What We Need
• Monitor the availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure across servers, compute clusters, and supporting systems, investigating alerts and anomalies as they arise.
• Triage incidents by assessing severity and impact, gathering diagnostic information, escalating issues to the appropriate engineering teams, and tracking them through resolution.
• Develop, maintain, and execute operational runbooks for troubleshooting, incident response, system recovery, and routine maintenance.
• Improve monitoring, dashboards, and alerting to increase infrastructure visibility, reduce alert noise, and enable earlier detection of potential failures.
• Analyze recurring incidents and operational gaps, collaborating with infrastructure and engineering teams to identify root causes, improve recovery procedures, and prevent repeat issues.
## What You Will Learn
• Gain hands-on experience supporting the infrastructure behind next-generation AI compute platforms, including servers, compute clusters, and large-scale systems.
• Deepen your understanding of Linux, hardware management, networking, storage, and the interactions between hardware and software in production environments.
• Build expertise in monitoring and observability tools, incident management, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure reliability practices.
• Develop practical skills in scripting and automation using tools such as Python, Bash, and Ansible to streamline troubleshooting and routine operations.
• Collaborate with infrastructure and engineering teams to improve operational maturity, strengthen incident response, and build more reliable and scalable AI compute infrastructure.

description:
## About Upstart
At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.
As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.
We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
## The Team
Upstart’s Machine Learning team applies machine learning and statistical methods to improve how we evaluate risk and make lending decisions. The team combines scientific research, experimentation, and engineering to develop models that support Upstart’s mission of expanding access to affordable credit.
As an Applied Scientist at Upstart, you will develop and evaluate machine learning models that address meaningful business problems. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional partners to translate complex data into modeling improvements and measurable outcomes.
## How you’ll make an impact
• Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models to improve predictive performance and support lending decisions.
• Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, develop features, and inform modeling approaches.
• Design and execute experiments to assess model performance, validate hypotheses, and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Collaborate with scientists and engineers to implement, monitor, and refine models in production environments.
• Document methodologies, communicate findings, and contribute to reproducible scientific workflows.
## Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 0–2 years of experience in machine learning, applied statistics, or a related quantitative field.
• Experience developing or evaluating machine learning models using Python.
• Experience applying statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, regression, or predictive modeling, to quantitative datasets.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced degree, ideally a PhD, in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
• Knowledge of supervised learning techniques, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
• Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
• Experience working with large-scale datasets using SQL or distributed data processing tools.
• Ability to communicate modeling approaches and experimental results to technical and nontechnical audiences.

The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

description:

En Tenpo somos líderes, somos valientes ante los desafíos y, sobre todo, somos humanos: conectamos de verdad con las necesidades de las personas y de nuestro país.
El futuro ya llegó y tiene licencia bancaria. Vamos con todo. Con fuerza. Con visión.
Con N de Neobanco. #TenpoConNdeNeobanco 💚
## Sobre el Cargo
Serás el responsable de diseñar e implementar los modelos de machine learning, motores de decisión y soluciones de inteligencia artificial que automatizan y optimizan procesos clave de Tenpo. Tu rol será clave para acelerar la adopción de una cultura AI-First en el neobanco, habilitando una propuesta de valor personalizada, eficiente y escalable para los clientes. Tu trabajo impactará directamente en los KPIs de crédito, retención, experiencia del cliente y eficiencia operacional.
## Responsabilidades del cargo
1. Desarrollo de Modelos de Machine Learning: Lidera la investigación, validación y puesta en producción de modelos predictivos y de clasificación (regresión, clasificación, clustering, causal inference, NLP).
2. Captura de Valor de Modelos y Soluciones: Mide, documenta y comunica el valor de negocio generado por cada modelo o solución en producción — valor capturado y valor potencial —, validando ese impacto con los stakeholders correspondientes y evitando que un modelo opere sin evidencia de resultado comercial atribuible.
3. Motores de Decisión y Recomendación:Diseña e implementa motores de decisión y sistemas de recomendación que soporten productos comerciales, de crédito y de experiencia del cliente en Tenpo.
4. Optimización del Ciclo de Lending: Diseña soluciones analíticas para mejorar el funnel de conversión de créditos, desde la prospección y originación, hasta la retención.
5. Traducción de Necesidades Comerciales en Modelos: Colabora activamente con Marketing, Producto, Tecnología y Riesgo para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones de modelado concretas y asegurar su adopción efectiva.
6. Referencia Técnica del Equipo: Actúa como referente técnico dentro de su equipo, revisando metodologías y validando implementaciones de Data Scientists Jr. y SS, contribuyendo al desarrollo de sus capacidades analíticas.

Profesional titulado/a en Ingeniería Matemática, Estadística, Ingeniería Civil en Informática, Física o carreras afines con base cuantitativa sólida.

Modelos de ML en producción en entornos de alto volumen transaccional.

Modelos en producción: regresión, clasificación, clustering, inferencia causal, NLP.

title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description:
## À propos de N2JSoft
N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.
Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.
N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.
L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.
Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.
Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.
En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).
## Quelques chiffres
230 collaborateurs, dont 50 dans l'équipe tech
Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.
## L’équipe tech
Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…
Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.
## Stack et pratiques
Front : Angular 16/21
Back : .NET 10 – C#
Infra : AWS
BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
Architecture : monolithe modulaire
Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.
Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).
## Requirements
## Le profil recherché
Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :
D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum
De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)
De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)
D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL
D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker
## Et tu fais preuve :
D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée
De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique
De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.
## Les points d’attention :
Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.
Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.
## Les plus :
Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable
Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées
Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies
Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute
La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre
## Processus de recrutement
## Préqualification avec nos recruteurs
Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)
Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)
## Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)
A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.
## Télétravail :
Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.
Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.
Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.
En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.
## Rémunération et avantages
40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique
## CDI cadre – 37h/semaine
## Prime de vacances
Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire
## Cours de musique sur site
## Événements d’équipe toute l’année
N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.
You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.
Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.
How it works
Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
Requirements
2+ years of professional software engineering
Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
Regular use of an AI coding tool
Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
At least 10 hours a week, starting now
A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)
Nice to have
Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
Experience building agent tasks or RL environments
Terms
Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Us:
Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.
About the Role
We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.
You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use.
What You'll Do
• Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses.
• Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization.
• Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate.
• Improve reliability, latency, and cost through prompt caching strategies, token budgets, retry logic, and observability.
• Write the tools agents use: API integrations with Pydantic validation, exercise search over local databases, structured workout submission.
What You Bring
• Strong Python skills: you've built and deployed services on large production systems.
• Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar agent frameworks.
• Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured output, evaluation.
• Comfort with async Python, HTTP APIs, and streaming protocols (SSE, webhooks).
• Experience with data validation and schema design (Pydantic, JSON Schema).
• Ability to debug across layers: from a broken LLM tool call to a misconfigured Terraform resource.
• Clear communication: you'll work directly with product, mobile, and backend engineers.
Nice to Have
• Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, ECR, CloudFront, S3, Cognito) or other cloud agent hosting.
• Observability and tracing tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
• Exposure to evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-judge, automated scoring, dataset management.
• Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK).

title: Product Designer - Visual Craft & AI
description:
Have you made something beautiful because you wanted it to exist?
Maybe you’ve built a small creative tool. Made an interface behave in a way we haven’t seen before. Used AI to turn an idea into something people can actually play with.
You’ve got a strong eye, ideas of your own and work to show for it. You might not have held a product design job yet.
We’re looking for a designer with exceptional visual craft, ideas of their own and the AI skills to turn them into working experiences. We’d like to see what you’re making.
Make things for people who make things
At Envato, we’re building tools that help creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. We want those tools to feel as creative and considered as the work people make with them.
We’re looking for someone with fresh ideas who brings excellent visual craft and is already using AI to explore and build. You could be coming from uni, independent projects, freelance work or another creative discipline. We’re not fussed about your current job title or background, but what we do care about is raw design talent who can bring something different to the team.
What you could get your hands on
You might prototype how a filmmaker saves a character reference and uses it across different shots. Explore how arranging and playing video clips could help someone see a story coming together. Or use motion, imagery and interaction to make an AI capability easier to understand and more enjoyable to use.
You’ll bring different approaches, make them interactive and try them with the team and customers. Then you’ll help develop the promising ones into experiences people can use.
This is work on the core product, not a separate collection of experiments that never makes it into customers’ hands. This work matters.
Bring your eye. Build your product experience
We want to see care in the typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. We’re interested in how you direct and work with AI.
You should be curious about the person using what you’ve made, willing to share unfinished work, test things in the wild and able to change your approach when you learn something.
You’ll work alongside experienced designers and engineers, with support on framing problems, testing ideas and getting work into the product. You won’t be expected to independently lead a whole product area from day one, but you will have real work to own, feedback to help you develop it and the opportunity to contribute things we haven’t yet thought of.
Show us what you’re making
To be considered, send us something you’ve built using AI, a finished product, prototype, website or interactive tool, and something that shows your visual craft. They can be the same project. Uni work, client work and independent experiments are all welcome.
Add a few lines about your contribution, the tools you used and the details you sweated.
Life at Envato
We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.
Our benefits include home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, and the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year.
You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.
A few things before you apply
We embrace diversity at Envato and what to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team.
We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.
We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.
By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information.

title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images

Strong knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL)
