title: Frontend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Help build the Portal, a modern web platform for fleet managers and technicians. As a Frontend Engineer (m/f/x), you will turn product ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces using React and TypeScript. Join a collaborative team that values autonomy, ownership, code quality, and learning, and deliver features with visible customer impact.

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team in Berlin (GER) that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

  • Build and deliver frontend features for the Portal using React and TypeScript.
  • Work with product, design, and backend specialists to translate requirements into user interfaces.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket communication, including asynchronous data, caching, and error handling.
  • Write clean, maintainable, performant code and unit and integration tests.
  • Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and frontend architectural decisions.
  • Troubleshoot existing features, improve performance, and share knowledge with other engineers.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with server-side rendering frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Proficiency with modern frontend tooling and state management, such as Redux or React Context.
  • Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, CSS-in-JS or styled-components, and responsive or adaptive design.
  • Familiarity with UI component libraries, design systems, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience with frontend build tools such as Webpack, Vite, or Babel, including bundler optimization.
  • Ability to integrate APIs and WebSocket communication and manage asynchronous data flows, errors, and caching.
  • An independent approach, ownership of your work, and clear communication with product, design, and engineering colleagues.

Even better would be

  • Experience writing developer tools, internal packages, or SDKs.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments.
  • Deeper familiarity with real-time or WebSocket architectures.
  • (Not a must) Proficiency in one or more backend languages / frameworks (e.g. Node.js / Express / NestJS / TypeScript, or similar)

What we offer

  • Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
  • A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
  • Flexible working hours
  • Mental well-being support via nilo.health
  • Employee discounts on our products
  • Corporate discounts on a variety of brands
About go-e
We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

Software Engineer

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

In November 2023 we launched our non-food retail offering, Deliveroo ‘Shopping’, where we work with large and small merchants. We oversee all operations within the grocery and retail ecosystem, ensuring stores are equipped to receive and efficiently process orders. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. You’ll be joining a multi-disciplinary engineering team focused on technical execution and collaboration.   • Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).

title: AI Resident UK/EMEA
description:
## About Ema
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
## The residency
The AI Residency is a 6-month builder role, not a research placement. Every engineer at Ema owns delivery end to end — from understanding the customer's problem to shipping, measuring and supporting it in production — and residents are held to the same bar. You won't be parked on one project: you'll contribute across several avenues, all toward one goal — creating real value and impact for our enterprise customers.
Real production work. You work in the production codebase, on real customer problems and real production data. Recent residents have shipped agent harnesses, eval infrastructure, inference-cost reductions, PII redaction, automated QA pipelines and backend service hardening used by enterprise customers.
End-to-end ownership. You take work from a problem statement to a shipped, measured result — design, build, test, launch, and the follow-through until it's reliable.
Mentorship. A senior mentor, weekly 1:1s, regular reviews with your team, and exposure to the founders and engineering leadership.
A path to full-time. Top-performing residents are offered full-time roles at Ema. Several of our engineers started as residents.
## Choose your specialist track
Whichever track you choose, you own delivery end to end. The track decides where you go deepest.
Backend. Go and Python services, APIs and data models for multi-tenant SaaS. Integrations that let agents take real actions in SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Teams and Slack.
AI/ML. Agents, harnesses and context engineering; evals and LLM judges calibrated against human labels; retrieval and memory; post-training (SFT, preference optimisation, RL) and distilling frontier behaviour into cheaper models.
Systems & Infra. Kubernetes and cloud (Azure, GCP), regional deployments and data residency, model serving, observability, CI/CD and reliability at enterprise scale.
## Where you'll contribute
Over the residency you'll work across several of these avenues, not just one:
Customer deployments. Build and ship AI Employees for UK and European enterprises, working with the people whose problem it is.
Platform and product. Turn patterns from the field into Ema's core product: new connectors, agent primitives, APIs and tooling.
Quality and evaluation. Make agents measurably better: benchmarks from real workflows, failure mining, and the loop where production traces become training and eval data.
Reliability and cost. Latency, uptime, inference cost and observability. Quality per pound is a metric we track.
Trust and compliance. PII detection and redaction, data residency, and audit-ready evidence for customers under UK GDPR and the EU AI Act.
## What we're looking for
A builder's mindset and high agency. You find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear, and you follow your work into production.
Final-year undergraduates, MSc/MEng and PhD students, recent graduates and self-taught builders are all welcome. What matters is what you've built.
Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and clean code in Python, Go or a similar language. You're comfortable in a large production codebase.
Real depth in your chosen track. Backend: services, APIs and data modelling. AI/ML: ML fundamentals, PyTorch, LLM systems or evals. Systems & Infra: Linux, containers, cloud and networking. One area you can teach us beats five you've touched.
Honest measurement as a habit. You define what "done" and "better" mean before you build, and you'd rather kill your own feature with a clean experiment than ship it on a hunch.
Clear communication. You can explain your work to engineers, customers and leadership, in writing and in person.
## Show us what you've built
The best way to capture our attention is to point us to something you've built. Include a link — a GitHub repo, a live URL, a demo, or a write-up — with your application.
## Logistics
Location: Hybrid, from our London office.
Term: 6 months, flexible start.
Stipend: £ 2,500 - £ 3,000 / month.
Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK for the length of the residency.
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

title: Research Engineer, Finetuning
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
We're looking for a Research Engineer to help make Claude more capable, reliable and useful on complex, real-world work. You'll work across research and engineering, from early ideas and experiments through to improvements in our models.
This is an early-stage team working on open-ended problems. Priorities will change as we learn, and you'll have a lot of ownership over what you work on. We're looking for someone who's excited about that, and who enjoys working closely with both research and product.
## Key responsibilities
Design and run experiments to improve model capabilities
Build reinforcement learning environments and evaluations
Develop the tools and infrastructure needed to support this research
Collaborate with teams across research, engineering and product
Help shape the direction of a new area of research
## Minimum qualifications
Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in Python
Experience training, fine-tuning or evaluating machine learning models
A track record of owning ambiguous technical projects end to end
Strong communication skills and a collaborative working style
Care about the societal impacts and safety of your work
## Preferred qualifications
Experience with reinforcement learning, particularly in long-horizon or sparse-reward settings
Experience building reinforcement learning environments, simulation systems or large-scale ML infrastructure
Experience building evaluations or benchmarks for agentic systems
Experience working closely with product teams to drive model improvements
## Representative projects
Build a simulation where decisions made early on have consequences much later, and use it to train a model
Design an evaluation for work that takes a long time and has no single right answer
Investigate where a model's independence breaks down on long projects, and run experiments to improve it
Develop a way for people to oversee a large amount of work without reviewing every step
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$500,000—$850,000 USD
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Software Engineer III
description:
## About Renaissance
When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.
Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.
## Job Description
As a Software Engineer III, you will build features across the discovery layer and the products behind it: the search and browse experiences teachers use to find the right lesson, the curation tools admins use to govern what their district sees, and the services that make four separate products feel like one library. You will be making it fast and intuitive for admins to govern and curate, for teachers to find and instruct, and for students to explore and grow their respective libraries. You will work with a high degree of independence and help ensure that problems and solutions are appropriately scoped.
In addition, you will be the first team to adopt Renaissance’s S3 model of software development. You will be expected to build multi-agent orchestration, where specialized agents coordinate on complete features and engineers shift from managing individual tasks to designing the systems that produce the work.
In this role as a Software Engineer III, you will:
• Build features across the discovery layer and the products it connects — search and browse for teachers, curation and governance for admins, exploration for students.
• Develop backend services that leverage relational databases, non-relational datastores, message queuing, and cloud infrastructure, against typed contracts.
• Build and test frontend experiences in TypeScript and React, contract-tested against the backend, with accessibility treated as a requirement rather than a follow-up.
• Write the tests and the instrumentation with the feature — unit, component, and contract tests, plus the traces, metrics, and logs that make the system debuggable.
## Qualifications
## For this role, you must have:
• Professional experience building and shipping production web applications or services.
• Experience developing backend services against relational databases, and comfort with non-relational datastores, message queuing, and/or cloud infrastructure.
• Excitement to help craft a new, AI-first software development lifecycle. The idea of encoding engineering understanding into formal constraints that can be consumed by an AI workflow is an interesting problem to you, not a necessary evil.
• Working knowledge of cloud operations — you can deploy across environments, read a dashboard, and troubleshoot an application problem in a cloud environment.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with distributed engineering, product, and design teams.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience.
Experience with various engineering technologies such as:
• SQL (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, etc.)
• Proficiency in a typed language, ideally TypeScript, and comfort working in a strictly typed codebase.
## Optionally, you could have:
• Experience leading and mentoring others
• Experience with the AWS technologies
• Knowledge of DevOps processes and technologies
## Additional information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
## Salary Range: The base range for this position is $99,500.00 - $136,800.00. This range is based on national market data and may vary by experience and location.

title: Backend Software Developer
description:
## Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact
Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.
Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.
Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.
## Jouw rol
Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.
## Wat je zal gaan doen:
Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).
Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).
Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.
Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.
Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.
## Requirements
## Wie ben jij?
We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.
Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWSCDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.
## Wat bieden wij jou?
De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.
Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.
Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).
Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.
Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.
Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.
Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.
Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.
Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.
De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.
Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.
## Over Dawn Technology
We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.
Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.
## Solliciteren
Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.
## Have a great day. Dawn Technology.
We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.
Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

description:
## About Klar
We're turning one of the world's largest underbanked markets into something fairer, simpler, and more transparent. 7 million users served since 2019. Klar Empresarial, a brand-new B2B solution bringing agile credit and smart accounts to SMEs who've been ignored by traditional banks for too long.

We move fast, we think big, and we go all in, because as our CEO puts it: "Growing doesn't always mean going further. Sometimes it means going deeper."
Behind all of it is a team of 30+ nationalities, working across Mexico City, Berlin, and Argentina, obsessed with building financial products that are simpler, faster, and fairer than anything that came before.
This is Klar, and we're seeking the people who'll write the next chapter.
## Our people
If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team that is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!
## Our values
• Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team.
• Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.
• Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.
• Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.
• Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do.
## About the role
We are looking for a hands-on DevOps & Database Engineer (DBA) who is passionate about building, automating, and maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure and database environments.
In this role, you'll combine strong Linux systems administration expertise with database management and DevOps practices to ensure the performance, security, and availability of our production systems.
You'll take ownership of infrastructure automation, vulnerability remediation, database performance and reliability, and virtualization environments, working closely with engineering and security teams to improve operational efficiency.
While Linux administration, PostgreSQL/MSSQL database management, and infrastructure automation will be at the heart of your responsibilities, you'll also contribute to our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD practices, and observability capabilities.
## What you can expect:
• Own and maintain our Linux production environments, ensuring their stability, performance, security, and availability across critical infrastructure.
• Drive infrastructure automation and configuration management using tools such as Ansible, Bash, and Python to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and streamline operations.
• Manage patching and vulnerability remediation at scale, from identifying and prioritizing vulnerabilities to deploying patches and validating remediation across infrastructure fleets.
• Ensure database reliability and performance by administering PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server environments, including performance tuning, backups, replication, failover, and disaster recovery.
• Manage and optimize our virtualization infrastructure, working with VMware ESXi, vSphere, and Cisco UCS to support reliable and efficient operations.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to operate and troubleshoot cloud-native infrastructure, including AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
• Strengthen infrastructure monitoring and observability using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar solutions to proactively identify and resolve issues.
• Contribute to secure and reliable infrastructure operations, including networking, certificate management, and CI/CD automation.
• Have meaningful ownership and autonomy, with the opportunity to improve infrastructure reliability, challenge existing processes, and make a tangible impact on our systems.
## What we are looking for:
• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Linux systems in production environments, particularly RHEL and/or Ubuntu, with mid-to-advanced troubleshooting and system administration skills.
• Strong experience with configuration management and infrastructure automation, using Ansible or similar tools, alongside practical scripting skills in Bash and Python.
• Proven experience managing patching and vulnerability remediation across multiple servers, including vulnerability scanning, risk-based prioritization, patch deployment, and remediation verification.
• Hands-on experience administering PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server, including performance optimization, backup and recovery, replication, failover, and disaster recovery.
• Practical experience with virtualization technologies, particularly VMware ESXi, vSphere, and Cisco UCS.
• Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform, with the ability to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain infrastructure environments.
• Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or equivalent solutions.
• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VPNs, TLS/mTLS, and certificate management.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows using GitHub Actions or similar platforms.
• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.
## Nice to have:
• Experience with Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), Samba, or OpenLDAP.
• Familiarity with Istio, Kafka, or Terragrunt.
• Experience managing multi-region AWS infrastructure and implementing cloud cost optimization initiatives.
• Previous experience working in fintech, banking, or other highly regulated environments.
## Our offer to you:
• Competitive salary based on performance and experience
• Chance of earning Klar stock options
• 26 days of paid vacation per year
• Computer devices
• Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions via Mantra Care
• International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people
• A world class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in

title: Data Analyst, Identification Accuracy
description:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence. We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.
Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.
We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io,MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar, Gradle).
Are you passionate about data analytics and eager to work on large-scale projects? Fingerprint is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Identification Accuracy Team. You will be the team's go-to analyst for questions about how accurately we identify browsers and devices: investigating accuracy questions from Customer Success and Sales, building the reporting and dashboards those teams rely on, and turning repeat requests into self-service tools. Our Identification API Product processes approximately 1 billion requests per month, so you will work hands-on with large-scale event data and the models behind it.
## Responsibilities:
• Act as the first point of contact for identification accuracy questions from Customer Success, Sales Engineering and Product: investigate reported false positives and false negatives, find the root cause, and explain it in terms customers and internal teams can act on.
• Lead accuracy analyses for strategic customers and prospects, including building customer-specific metrics from the customer's own data (for example, account IDs) when our standard metrics don't fit their use case.
• Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that support Customer Success and the Sales Engineering organizations, such as customer accuracy health reports and weekly book-of-business summaries.
• Build self-service tools, including AI-assisted ones, that let teams answer routine accuracy questions without waiting on an analyst, and drive their internal adoption.
• Model and maintain analytics data with dbt on ClickHouse (aggregates, incremental models and tests) so dashboards stay fast, trustworthy and documented.
• Monitor Identification accuracy, detect anomalies, and analyze trends in time-series data, raising issues before customers notice them.
• Document findings and investigation playbooks so knowledge is reusable across the team.
• Foster an engineering-focused, data-driven culture within the Fingerprint team by sharing tools and knowledge on effective data analytics approaches.
• This role includes participation in a shared on-call rotation. The schedule will be communicated in advance, and we strive to balance coverage equitably while minimizing off-hours disruptions.
## Qualifications:
• Proficiency in English for clear communication within an international remote team.
• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or Data Science.
• Strong SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and writing efficient queries over large event-level datasets.
• Strong foundation in statistics for designing metrics, sizing impact, and telling a real change from noise.
• Practical experience with analytical storage solutions such as Clickhouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, etc.
• Experience building dashboards and using data visualization tools like Apache Superset, Tableau, Metabase, Looker, etc.
• Strong coding skills with clean, maintainable code; experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development practices
• Experience investigating data discrepancies and root-causing anomalies, including reconciling your numbers with a stakeholder's or customer's own analysis.
• Demonstrated experience supporting internal teams by managing a queue of data and reporting requests and prioritizing by impact and urgency.
• Comfortable conducting ad-hoc analysis and presenting findings to cross-functional teams
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex data clearly to non-technical audiences, including customer-facing teams who will share your findings with customers.
## Nice to Haves:
• Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and approaches (e.g., dbt, materialized views, incremental models, data pipeline tools).
• Proficiency with the Python data analytics stack (Numpy, pandas, Jupyter, etc.). Expected for the Senior Data Analyst level.
• Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, coding agents, MCP) to automate analysis workflows or build internal tools.
• Understanding of fundamental ML concepts, familiarity with model evaluation metrics (precision and recall, false positive and false negative trade-offs).
• Background in fraud prevention, identity, device intelligence, or another domain where accuracy errors carry a real cost.
• Experience working directly with Customer Success, Sales, or Support teams in a B2B SaaS company.
## Technologies:
• Our stack: Clickhouse, DBT, Apache Superset (Preset), Prefect, Python and Jupyter, Claude
• Relevant technologies: Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Apache Druid, Vertica, DataBricks, Apache Airflow, Dataform, Talend, Fivetran, Stitch, Luigi, Dagster, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, Redash
## Compensation & Transparency
At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it's part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.
Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $115k - $155k
Some example salaries for specific locations are below:
NYC: $135k - $155k
Chicago: $115k - $132k
Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate's location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.
We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

title: Software Engineer, Front End
description:
Want to build instead of inherit? System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up.
This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows.
We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack.
We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions.
If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
## What You’ll Do
Own the Frontend Application Layer: Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
Build Production-Ready Experiences: Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high-quality application features.
Integrate with APIs: Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows.
Shape Frontend Architecture: Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards.
Work Across Engineering Boundaries: Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application.
Build Efficient Development Workflows: Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment.
Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity: Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output.
Automate Where It Makes Sense: Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows.
Deliver Iteratively: Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process.
Contribute Beyond Your Code: Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices.
## What Success Looks Like
## Within your first six months, you will have:
• Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application.
• Built and delivered production-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience.
• Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs.
• Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain.
• Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers.
• Integrated AI-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality.
• Become a trusted technical partner to product leadership, backend development, QA, and other members of the engineering team.
## Must Haves
• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on experience building modern frontend applications.
• Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern component-based frontend development.
• Professional experience with React or another modern frontend framework. React experience is preferred, but strong engineers coming from comparable frameworks will be considered.
• Experience designing and building reusable frontend components and responsive application interfaces.
• Hands-on experience integrating applications with RESTful APIs or comparable backend services.
• Experience using Git and GitHub in a collaborative software engineering environment.
• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and modern software development workflows.
• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including maintainability, testing, debugging, source control, and code review.
• Ability to work independently through ambiguous technical problems and clearly explain the reasoning behind your implementation decisions.
• Experience using AI-assisted software development tools for activities such as code generation, testing, documentation, debugging, or development acceleration—and the technical judgment to validate their output.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment.
## Nice to Haves
• Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up.
• Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
• Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud-based application delivery.
• Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams.
• Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
• Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards.
• Experience with automated frontend or unit testing.
• Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
## Who Will Thrive in This Role
You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining.
You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software.
You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides.
Most importantly, you want ownership. This is an opportunity to help establish something new rather than simply inherit what someone else already built.
## What is the Compensation Range for this role?
The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $145,000 annually for full-time status. Actual compensation within this range at Veilant is determined by numerous factors including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, including experience, education, certifications, technical skills, as well as contract-specific affordability and labor categories, the scope and responsibilities of the role, market and business considerations, and geographic location.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Perception
description:
## Build the Path Forward
At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.
Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.
We're seeking passionate CV/ML Engineers to join our team at the intersection of welding science and artificial intelligence. We currently have experienced (L3/L4), senior (L5) and staff (L6) level openings within the team. You'll use your skills in problem solving, computer vision, deep learning, and Python programming to tackle challenges in our field alongside our talented teams.
## What You’ll Do
Experienced:
• Implement, validate, and iterate on machine learning algorithms for weld perception tasks, including point cloud registration, seam detection, and joint geometry estimation, progressively expanding coverage across joint types and part geometries.
• Build and maintain data pipelines for training and evaluating perception models, spanning annotated 3D scan data ingestion, synthetic data generation, and structured dataset management for iterative model improvement.
• Run rigorous model evaluation experiments, including failure mode analysis, FP/FN rate characterization, and benchmarking against quantitative registration accuracy thresholds, and communicate findings clearly to guide next steps.
• Integrate trained models into production ROS-based robotics services, ensuring low-latency inference and compatibility with deployed cell configurations.
• Write clean, well-tested Python code; participate actively in code and experiment reviews; and maintain clear documentation of methods, parameters, and results.
Senior/Staff:
• Lead research, development, and production deployment of advanced perception algorithms spanning point cloud registration, seam detection, and real-time in-process tracking across structured light, RGB, and stereo sensors.
• Design and lead experiments evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning models, including transformer-based and geometric feature learning architectures
• Design and lead real-time perception systems such as during-weld seam tracking, applying sensor fusion with probabilistic state estimation (e.g., Kalman filtering) to achieve robust weld performance.
• Define and own the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from dataset design and annotation strategy through training, benchmarking, and fleet deployment, with clear go/no-go evaluation frameworks.
• Architect distributed training and hyperparameter optimization workflows; drive strategy for data acquisition, annotation tooling, and synthetic vs. real scan data usage.
• Mentor engineers across levels, providing technical leadership on perception systems and ML methodology.
Who You Are
• Master's or Ph.D. in CS, Robotics, or related field (Computer Vision, ML, or Perception); Bachelor's with strong production ML experience also considered.
• 3+ years (Experienced) / 7+ years (Senior/Staff) in real-world robotics or industrial ML.
• Strong Python fluency and hands-on PyTorch experience, including training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models in production.
• Experience with 3D point cloud data and libraries such as Open3D, including geometric concepts like surface segmentation, spatial queries, and point-wise labeling.
• Familiarity with 3D deep learning architectures such as PointNet++, GeoTransformer, or similar transformer-based or graph-based approaches on geometric data.
• Comfortable integrating ML models into production robotics services within ROS-based architectures and containerized deployment environments.
• Senior/Staff: Demonstrated track record leading end-to-end ML projects from dataset design through fleet deployment with rigorous go/no-go frameworks; experience architecting distributed training and hyperparameter optimization workflows
Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team
• Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
• 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)
• 401(k) retirement plan through Empower
• Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!
## Who We Are
At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
description:

AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team.
The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem.
Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.
As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process.
What to expect
Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost.
Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up.
Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building.
Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback.
Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality.
Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down.
Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next.
Inspire us by
Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus.
Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them.
Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus.
End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality.
Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders.
Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving.
Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus.
What we offer
Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)
Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties
Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance
Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany
Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort
Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best
Innovation through diversity
Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Data Engineer / Data Architect with strong banking or financial-services experience to design and implement an enterprise data dictionary and knowledge layer that supports AI and agentic applications. The role combines data architecture, knowledge modelling, governance and hands-on Databricks implementation.
## Key responsibilities
• Design the target architecture for an enterprise data dictionary and semantic/knowledge layer.
• Model business entities, attributes, relationships, taxonomies, classifications, synonyms, business terminology and rules.
• Design knowledge structures that can be consumed by AI agents, GenAI solutions and other agentic applications.
• Define how existing business rules and business logic will populate, enrich and validate the knowledge layer.
• Translate the target architecture into scalable Databricks data structures, pipelines and implementation patterns.
• Use Spark/PySpark and SQL where required to engineer, transform, test and operationalise data products and knowledge-layer components.
• Support simulation, prototyping and testing using Microsoft Dataverse where applicable.
• Define lineage, traceability, evaluation, validation and quality controls for the model and its outputs.
• Establish governance, ownership and day-to-day operating processes for maintaining and evolving enterprise knowledge.
• Define security, access, audit and change controls appropriate to a regulated financial-services environment.
• Work with business, data, architecture, governance and AI stakeholders to convert banking concepts into implementable technical structures.
## Mandatory experience and skills
• Strong banking or financial-services domain experience with the ability to model complex business concepts and terminology.
• Senior-level hands-on experience in Data Architecture and/or Data Engineering, including solution design and implementation ownership.
• Demonstrable Databricks architecture and implementation experience in enterprise environments.
• Practical Spark/PySpark and SQL capability sufficient to guide or deliver data engineering and validation activities.
• Enterprise data modelling and data-dictionary design, including conceptual, logical and physical modelling.
• Entity and relationship modelling plus metadata, taxonomy, synonym, classification and business-rule modelling.
• Data governance, lineage, traceability, quality, evaluation and validation design.
• Experience designing data structures or semantic models that support AI, GenAI or advanced analytics applications.
• Strong architecture documentation, stakeholder facilitation and solution-design communication skills.
• Ability to move from architecture concepts to working prototypes and production implementation patterns.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.
The Data Analyst – Technology is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for querying, analyzing, and reporting on Medicare Advantage healthcare data to support operational decision-making and regulatory compliance across technology operations. This role works closely with the Senior Data Analyst, product managers, and platform engineers to translate business requirements into analytical outputs — including reports, dashboards, and data validations — within an agile development environment. The Data Analyst builds foundational expertise in healthcare data domains including claims, member/eligibility, and provider data, and contributes to the team's data quality and documentation standards. This position is a key development role on the path toward senior-level analytical ownership and growing specialization in Medicare Advantage data platforms.
## Job Duties/Responsibilities
Data Analysis & Querying: Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze healthcare datasets — including medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data — in support of operational reporting and ad hoc analytical requests.
Requirements Gathering Support: Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies and assist in translating business requirements into analytical specifications, data mappings, and reporting logic under the guidance of senior team members.
Reporting & Dashboard Support: Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools that present healthcare data clearly for operational and compliance audiences.
Data Quality Validation: Apply data quality checks, validate source-to-target mappings, and identify anomalies or inconsistencies in healthcare datasets to support data integrity and audit readiness.
Regulatory & Compliance Reporting: Support the production of HEDIS, STAR ratings, CMS encounter, and risk adjustment reporting outputs by executing defined analytical processes and validating results against established data standards.
Documentation & Process Support: Maintain analytical documentation — including query libraries, data dictionaries, and process notes — to support team knowledge continuity and operational handoff requirements.
Continuous Learning & AI Awareness: Develop familiarity with cloud data platforms, data modeling concepts, and AI-assisted analytics tools, and actively build skills that support growth toward the Senior Data Analyst level.
## Supervisory Responsibilities
This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
## Job Requirements
## Experience
## Required:
• 3–5 years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a closely related analytical function
• Demonstrated hands-on experience writing SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation in a production or near-production environment
• Experience working with healthcare data, including at least one of the following domains: medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, or provider data
• Working knowledge of reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI platform
• Familiarity with working in an agile or scrum team environment, including participation in sprint ceremonies and iterative delivery
• Experience in a regulated data environment with exposure to data quality validation, HIPAA requirements, or PHI/PII handling practices
## Preferred:
• Experience in a Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or managed care health plan environment
• Exposure to CMS reporting requirements, HEDIS measures, STAR ratings logic, or risk adjustment data
• Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or data transformation tools (e.g., Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent)
• Experience applying AI-assisted or automated analytics tools to routine analytical workflows
## Education
## Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Informatics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience will be considered
## Preferred:
• Progress toward or completion of a Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline
## Training
## Required:
• Demonstrated proficiency in SQL through direct work experience; equivalent hands-on experience accepted in lieu of formal training
• Working knowledge of at least one BI or data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent), demonstrated through project or work experience
## Preferred:
• Introductory or intermediate training in cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
• Completion of relevant healthcare data analytics coursework or professional development (e.g., AHIMA, CPHIMS, or equivalent)
• Exposure to AI-augmented analytics tools or data storytelling training
## Skills & Competencies
## Technical/Role-Specific Skills
SQL & Data Querying: Solid, hands-on SQL skills for data extraction, filtering, joining, and basic transformation across relational databases; ability to write and maintain queries for recurring analytical needs.
Healthcare Data Domains: Working knowledge of medical claims, pharmacy claims, member/eligibility, and provider data structures, with growing familiarity with EDI standards (834/837), ICD-10/CPT codes, and CMS data formats.
BI & Data Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools for building and maintaining operational dashboards, standard reports, and data summaries for business and compliance audiences.
Data Quality & Validation: Ability to apply data quality checks, identify anomalies, and validate outputs against source data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance readiness across healthcare datasets.
Data Documentation: Demonstrated ability to write and maintain clear analytical documentation including query logic, data dictionaries, source-to-target notes, and process runbooks.
Cloud Platform Awareness: Basic familiarity with cloud data environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and willingness to develop hands-on proficiency in cloud-native analytics tools such as Databricks or Azure Data Factory.
Analytical Communication: Ability to translate data findings into clear written summaries and visualizations that support non-technical stakeholders in making informed operational decisions.
## Licensure
## Required: None
## Preferred: None
## Essential Physical Functions
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.
• The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

title: Field CTO, AI Factory
description:
## About the Company
Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.
With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.
Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.
## About the Role
The Field CTO, AI Factory is Armada's most senior technical voice in front of the largest players in the AI ecosystem. You are the trusted advisor who helps them design, justify and land multi-megawatt deployments of the latest xPU infrastructure on Armada's modular platform.
This is a customer-facing executive technologist role. You will spend your time in the room with CTOs, heads of infrastructure and chief architects; on stage at the industry's most important events; and alongside senior technical leaders within the AI partner ecosystem. You will also carry what you hear back into Armada as the voice of the customer, shaping the product roadmap.
Team: Solutions Engineering
Reports to: SVP, Solutions Engineering
Location: United States Remote
Travel: Significant; customer sites, partner and industry events
## Location
## United States (Remote)
## What you'll do
## 1. Engage the biggest players in the AI ecosystem
• Drive the go-to-market senior technical relationship with Armada's most strategic customers, such as the hyperscalers, frontier model builders, neoclouds, sovereign AI programs and the largest enterprise AI adopters at the edge.
• Engage with CTOs, chief architects and heads of infrastructure and compute, earning a seat in their capacity and architecture planning well ahead of any procurement.
• Translate their constraints (time to power, time to first token, density, sovereignty, cost per token) into a clear point of view on where modular AI factories fit in their capacity strategy.
• Partner with Armada's CTO and Engineering office, sales and commercial leaders to help shape and close solutions architectures for multi-megawatt, multi-site agreements.
• Work with AI partner ecosystem, such as NVIDIA, Dell, and WWT, in joint go-to-market opportunities, events, and field alignment
2. Lead complex solutioning on the latest GPU infrastructure, as a trusted advisor
• Lead architecture for large-scale deployments of current and next-generation xPU platforms on Leviathan, covering rack-scale systems, high-density power, direct liquid cooling, and high-performance back-end and front-end networking.
• Guide customers through the hard trade-offs: density versus serviceability, power source and redundancy, cooling topology, network fabric design, interconnected tenancy models (dedicated and sovereign versus multi-tenant), and phasing from first module to 100+ MW campus.
• Stay ahead of the leading chip design roadmap and reference architectures, so customers hear what is coming from you before they hear it elsewhere.
• Stay engaged from design through delivery. Requirements shift constantly on deployments of this scale, and you remain the customer's technical point of trust until the site is live.
• Set the technical bar for Armada's Solutions Engineers on AI factory pursuits, and coach them on the most complex deals.
3. Build Armada's market presence and bring the customer's voice home
• Represent Armada as a keynote speaker, panelist and briefing lead at the industry's flagship events, including events such as NVIDIA GTC, Dell Technologies World, Supercomputing, OCP Global Summit and Data Center World to name a few.
• Build deep working relationships with senior technical leaders across the partner ecosystem (examples: NVIDIA, Dell, Microsoft, power, cooling and networking, and integration partners) and drive joint reference architectures and co-authored points of view.
• Publish and present original thinking on private and sovereign AI infrastructure: including the value of modular options, speed to capacity, stranded and alternative power, liquid cooling at scale, and sovereignty dynamics for purpose-built AI infrastructure.
• Act as the voice of the customer inside Armada. Bring structured, evidence-based insight from the field to Product and Engineering, and directly influence the Leviathan and platform roadmap.
• Brief analysts, press and investors as an official spokespersons and authoritative technical voice within the company.
## Core competencies
We are looking for someone who operates at the highest level in all five of these areas.
Executive presence + making the complex simple. Commands a room of C-level technologists and a keynote stage equally well. Explains a gigawatt-class architecture to in five minutes, without notes and without jargon, and goes as deep as the engineers want in the next meeting.
Technical fluency across the AI factory stack. Expert, current knowledge of data center design (power distribution, redundancy, density), xPU platforms and reference architectures, liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, CDUs, facility loops), and AI networking (InfiniBand, Ethernet fabrics, optics, interconnection, wireless connectivity). Credible with specialists in each domain.
Demonstrated ability to influence and mentor. A track record of changing the direction of customer architectures, partner programs and internal product roadmaps without direct authority. Can point to specific decisions that went differently because they were in the room. Experience mentoring other solutions engineers.
Partner ecosystem experience. Established senior relationships at NVIDIA, Dell and other silicon, OEM, cooling, power, and networking partners. Has built joint solutions, co-sold at the executive level, and knows how to move a partner organization.
Tenure as a senior customer-facing technologist. A long, progressive career in roles such as Field CTO, Principal Architect, or senior Solutions Engineering, with repeated ownership of the technical win on the largest and most complex infrastructure deals.
## Required Qualifications
• 10-15 years in senior customer-facing technical infrastructure roles.
• Direct, recent experience architecting large-scale xPU deployments, including liquid-cooled, high-density environments.
• Deep working knowledge of data center power, cooling, networking and interconnection at multi-megawatt scale.
• Experience selling to and advising hyperscalers, AI-native companies, neoclouds or sovereign programs at the executive level.
• A visible public profile: keynotes, panels, published writing or recognized standing in the AI infrastructure community.
• Proven record of feeding field insight into product decisions that shipped.
• Comfortable in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where the playbook is still being written.
• Relevant certifications (for example NVIDIA) are a plus. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
## Compensation & Benefits
For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed below, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).
Compensation
$310,000—$387,000 USD
## You're a Great Fit if You're
• A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
• A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
• Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
• A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
• Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.
