title: Product Designer (AI Products & Platforms)
description:
Kyivstar.Tech is looking for a Product Designer to help shape and develop innovative AI-powered products and experiences.
We are looking for a designer who goes beyond traditional interface design and takes a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to product development. Someone who deeply understands AI technologies, recognizes opportunities emerging from their capabilities, and can independently turn those opportunities into meaningful product concepts and user experiences.
This is not a role focused on simply translating predefined requirements into interfaces. We expect a designer who actively contributes to product discovery, challenges assumptions, explores emerging technologies, and proposes new ways AI can create value for users and businesses.
A strong understanding of how modern AI systems work is essential. You should be comfortable discussing LLMs, AI agents, orchestration, integrations, and technical constraints with engineers, while keeping your primary focus on product thinking and user experience.
You’ll work closely with Product Owners, engineers, Business Analysts, and other team members, contributing to product direction, exploring new opportunities, and delivering innovative AI-powered experiences.
## About us
Kyivstar.Tech is a Ukrainian hybrid IT company and a resident of Diia.City. We are a subsidiary of Kyivstar, one of Ukraine’s largest telecom operators.
Our mission is to transform lives in Ukraine and beyond by creating innovative technological solutions that unleash the potential of businesses while meeting the evolving needs of users.
With over 700 specialists working across diverse domains—from mobile and web solutions to the design, development, support, and maintenance of high-performance systems—we are committed to driving meaningful change.
We embrace an entrepreneurial culture that fosters continuous growth, challenges conventional thinking, and inspires the creation of transformative products.
## What you will do
• Drive AI-powered product innovation: Proactively identify new product opportunities, explore emerging AI capabilities, and propose innovative use cases and experiences that create value for users and businesses.
• Contribute to product direction: Collaborate with Product Owners, engineers, and stakeholders to shape product concepts, challenge assumptions, and influence product decisions rather than simply executing predefined requirements.
• Apply technology-driven product thinking: Explore what becomes possible through AI technologies, translating their capabilities and limitations into meaningful product solutions without relying exclusively on established user problems or conventional UX patterns.
• Understand the technology behind the product: Work closely with engineers to understand LLM capabilities, AI orchestration, agent workflows, APIs, system integrations, and architectural constraints, using this knowledge to inform product and design decisions.
• Design AI platform experiences: Create intuitive interfaces for configuring, managing, monitoring, and interacting with AI-powered systems, agents, and workflows.
• Explore new human-AI interaction models: Design conversational experiences, intelligent assistants, embedded AI functionality, and innovative interaction patterns that go beyond traditional graphical interfaces.
• Develop functional AI prototypes: Independently create working prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions, integrating AI models and APIs when necessary to demonstrate and validate product concepts.
• Lead proactive product discovery: Independently formulate hypotheses, investigate potential use cases, explore alternative solutions, and identify opportunities even when established user workflows, detailed requirements, or historical analytics are unavailable.
• Validate ideas through experimentation: Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on product concepts using user research, usability testing, technical experimentation, and qualitative or quantitative feedback.
• Apply systems thinking: Design coherent, scalable experiences across interconnected products, services, and AI components, considering system behavior, user roles, integrations, and evolving requirements.
• Integrate AI into everyday design work: Actively use AI-powered tools for research, ideation, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and design-to-development workflows, continuously exploring more effective approaches.
• Deliver high-quality product experiences: Produce thoughtful UX solutions, polished interfaces, interactive prototypes, and clear design specifications, applying and extending the corporate design system where appropriate.
• Collaborate throughout implementation: Work closely with developers to ensure product concepts are technically feasible, appropriately implemented, and consistent with the intended user experience.
• Evaluate and improve product effectiveness: Define meaningful success criteria, analyze user feedback and product performance, and continuously refine solutions based on evidence and emerging opportunities
## Qualifications and experience needed
Product Design Experience: Proven Product Designer with a strong track record of independently designing and delivering complex digital products and contributing to product-level decisions.
Personal AI Projects: Demonstrable experience independently creating AI-powered prototypes, experimental applications, micro-products, or functional product concepts. Candidates must be able to present concrete examples of their own work, demonstrate how AI is used within these solutions, and explain their personal contribution to their design and implementation.
• Entrepreneurial Product Mindset: Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities, generate product ideas, challenge established approaches, and take initiative without waiting for predefined requirements or detailed instructions.
• Deep AI Understanding: Strong practical understanding of LLMs, AI agents, AI-powered tools, and the principles behind modern AI applications, including their capabilities, limitations, and potential product applications.
• Technical Literacy: Ability to understand and discuss AI system architecture, orchestration, APIs, integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies with engineering teams. Software engineering experience is not required.
• Technology-Driven Innovation: Ability to translate emerging technological capabilities into valuable product concepts, use cases, and user experiences, supported by practical experimentation rather than theoretical knowledge alone.
• Functional AI Prototyping — Required: Practical ability to build working interactive prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions. Experience connecting prototypes to AI models or APIs and experimenting with actual AI behavior is expected. Professional programming skills are not required.
• AI-Integrated Design Workflow: Confident, everyday use of AI-powered tools across research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and design production—ability to structure effective AI-assisted workflows and critically evaluate generated outputs.
• AI Experience Design: Understanding of the distinctive challenges of AI-powered interfaces, including non-deterministic behavior, user control, transparency, error handling, and building trust in AI-assisted interactions.
• Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex products holistically, identify relationships between components and processes, and design scalable experiences across interconnected systems.
• Product Discovery & Validation: Experience independently identifying opportunities, framing hypotheses, conducting research, validating concepts, and iterating based on user feedback and experimental results.
• UX/UI Design Expertise: Strong skills in information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping, with the ability to deliver polished, intuitive experiences for complex digital products.
• Design Systems & Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, variables, and interactive prototyping, alongside experience working with and extending established design systems.
• Mindset: Curious, analytical, experimental, and comfortable with ambiguity. Motivated to explore unfamiliar technologies, challenge assumptions, continuously learn, and independently turn ideas into tangible results.
• Team Fit: Strong communication and collaboration skills, experience working in cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams, and Intermediate+ proficiency in English and Ukrainian.
## A plus would be
• Commercial AI Product Experience: Previous experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, intelligent assistants, AI agents, conversational interfaces, or enterprise AI platforms.
• Advanced AI Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with agent orchestration, tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, and other architectural approaches used in modern AI applications.
• Enterprise Integration Experience: Experience working with enterprise platforms, customer support systems, CRM solutions, or products that integrate with multiple internal and external services.
• Advanced AI Development Workflows: Experience building more sophisticated AI applications, implementing multi-step agentic workflows, integrating multiple AI services, or using AI-assisted development tools to automate complex tasks.
• B2B SaaS & Platform Design: Experience designing configurable, modular, or API-driven platforms intended for integration into third-party products and services.
• AI Evaluation & Observability: Familiarity with approaches to evaluating AI behavior, monitoring system performance, and designing interfaces that help users understand and control AI-powered processes.
• Accessibility & Inclusive Design: Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards and experience applying inclusive design principles to complex digital experiences.
## What we offer

• Remote onboarding
• Performance bonuses for everyone (annual or quarterly — depends on the role)
• We train employees, with the opportunity to learn through the company’s library, internal resources, and programs from partners
• Health and life insurance
• Wellbeing program and corporate psychologist
• Reimbursement of expenses for Kyivstar mobile communication

title: Clinical AI Quality Specialist
description:
## About Hello Heart:
Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.
We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.
This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.
We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.
About the roleHello Heart’s AI team builds Nia, an AI health assistant for people managing their cardiovascular health. As a Clinical AI Quality Specialist, you will evaluate and monitor Nia’s clinical behavior before and after release, working alongside the Clinical AI Quality & Governance Team Lead. You will run evaluations, review production conversations, and turn findings into documented decisions with product and engineering. This is a hands-on role for a clinician who is comfortable working with AI tools.
## Responsibilities
• Run Nia’s offline evaluations for clinically relevant changes. Write test cases, including tricky and ambiguous ones, and score outputs against the expected clinical behavior. Build and maintain evaluation datasets and contribute to scoring methods
• Review production conversations using defined sampling methods. Take part in the weekly review and help prepare monthly results that state what was and wasn’t covered.
• Test whether Nia detects and correctly handles high-risk situations, including medical emergencies, self-harm, and medication safety. Measure how often it escalates too much or too little.
• Describe each failure clearly enough for engineering to act on, and flag your best read of the cause (for example, a wrong answer, missing patient context, or an escalation that fired too late). Make sure each unsafe or incorrect finding has an owner, a ticket, and a decision.
• Keep clinical specifications, review records, and evidence current and auditable. Write clear, precise clinical assessments that engineering and product can act on.
## Qualifications:
• PharmD (or equivalent clinical doctorate) with an active US license. 3+ years of combined clinical practice and clinical AI evaluation.
• Questions assumptions and investigates before drawing conclusions. Reads current guidelines, drug labels, and primary sources, and cites them in written assessments. Uses AI tools to work faster, and verifies AI output against sources before relying on it.
• Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, reviewing production conversations, and using monitoring tools (e.g., Langfuse).
• Command of triage and escalation, crisis and self-harm handling, and medication safety, grounded in current guidelines.
• Comfortable working with AI tools and evaluation workflows.
• Excellent written and verbal communication. Explains clinical risk clearly to engineering and product audiences, writes precise clinical assessments and documentation, and accepts feedback without defensiveness.
• Genuine passion for how AI can improve preventive care and chronic disease management. Curious, open to learning, and comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-moving field.
## Preferred Qualifications:
• Clinical experience in cardiovascular care or hypertension management.
• Experience with structured rating of clinical transcripts, including agreement between raters.
• Experience reviewing crisis and self-harm behavior.
• Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, or using monitoring tools such as Langfuse.

title: AI Transformation Architect [IC4]
description:
## Who we are
Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.
With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.
Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.
If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.
## Working hours
🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.
## Preferred location:
• USA
## Why this job is exciting
Every engineering organization has bought coding agents. Yet very few can confidently tell you that they’re making the impact they thought they would. They are falling short, not because the model isn’t good enough, but because the codebase is too complex and, outside of a few thousand people employed by OpenAI and Anthropic, nobody understands what good context looks like. Agents can’t access all the code they need, they burn tokens hunting for the right code, and fill the gaps by guessing. Organizations build internal harnesses and knowledge bases using techniques that are outdated before the product is even in use. You’ll be the person to show customers how to actually fix these problems.
Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, and agents write more code, having the right context matters more and more.
Being a brand new role, you’ll be building from scratch. You’ll define what the AI maturity curve looks like inside of enterprise organizations, turn that into a framework customers can use to assess themselves against, and lead engagements with customers where you’ll directly dig into their environment, build an action plan, and work with them to action it. Then you’ll measure again and show what changed and the results they’ve achieved.
You’ll spend your time in customer environments, in the room with VPs of Engineering and staff engineers, and in the product. You’ll also shape the broader market’s view on what good context looks like for agents, which is a question the whole industry is still figuring out. Your results will show up in how customers use the Sourcegraph platform and in the ways they are able to actually make agents work in enterprise codebases.
## 📅 Within one month, you will…
• Build relationships across Sales, Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product
• Learn our products, our value prop, and how our largest customers use Sourcegraph
• Shadow customer calls and interview customers about where their agents succeed and fail today
• Review our existing benchmark studies and draft a first point of view on the dimensions of context that matter most
## 📅 Within one quarter, you will…
• Publish Sourcegraph’s first perspective on context maturity, grounded in what you’ve learned from customer conversations and our own data
• Ship v1 of the maturity framework: the categories, the criteria that define each stage, and how evidence maps to a score
• Partner with Marketing to launch a self-serve version
• Equip Solutions Engineers to run a lightweight version of the assessment inside of trials
• Run your first assessment with 1-2 select customers, and refine the framework based on what you find
📅 Within six months, you will…
• Be a recognized voice on context and agent readiness, with a steady cadence of writing, talks, or research that engineering leaders reference
• Publish findings from real assessments: what you’re seeing across enterprise codebases, where agents break, and what moves the needle
• Own a repeatable paid engagement with a defined scope, deliverables, and readout
• Deliver action plans that customers execute with you — activating workflows, integrations, and agentic use cases in their own environment
• Re-measure your first customers and show movement up the curve
• Feed what you learn back to EPD as a standing input on agent effectiveness in the enterprise
## About you
You’re a consultant at heart, with technical chops and credibility. You can walk into a complex engineering organization, find what’s broken, and leave with a plan people act on. You’re equally comfortable telling a VP of Engineering their environment isn’t where they think it is as you are debating a staff engineer on why.
You build things that didn’t exist before: frameworks, practices, points of view. You can turn insight into action and you’re energized by a blank page as a starting point.
Finally, you’re in the middle of the AI shift yourself. You have deep experience and strong opinions on where agents work and where they don’t, and you share them publicly. You stay on top of AI development, use new models and harnesses as they’re released, and have a perspective on how every generation of these products changes the story.
## Your skill-set:
• 7+ years experience advising enterprise technology or engineering organizations
• Systems or solutions architecture experience in large-scale software, the developer ecosystem, or SDLC environments
• Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a point of view on how enterprises are adopting them
• Experience creating structured, repeatable approaches to diagnosing problems, such as frameworks, assessments, playbooks, or methodologies others can use
• Experience turning technical findings into an executive-ready business roadmap, then working hands-on with customers to deliver it
## Nice to Have
• You’ve run your own consulting practice or built a consultative services offering from scratch
• Background in developer tooling, platform engineering, developer experience, or DevOps
• A public voice - writing or speaking - you have a body of work people reference
• Experience with consumption or usage-based products
## Level
📊 This job is an IC4. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.
## Compensation
💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.
Your salary is determined by your pay band for the IC4 job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.
💰 The salary for this role is $200,000 USD.
📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.
## Interview process
Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!
We expect the interview process to take about 4.25 hours in total.
👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…
• Working session with Aimee, Sales, Customer success (45 min)
• Values Interview (30 min)
• CEO interview (30 min)
Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.
## Learn more about us
You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.
We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

title: Shopify Developer (Independent Contractor)
description:
Love Wellness is looking for an independent Shopify developer to partner with our ecomm team. You'll know our ecommerce stack inside out, build and launch what we ship on lovewellness.com, and lead QA and fixes. You'll work closely with our Senior Director of Ecommerce and the ecomm team.
We're a small, collaborative team, and you'll be our technical partner: when an idea comes up, you help shape how it gets built, not just build it.
In a typical month you might build a new landing page for a product launch, set up a promo that swaps offers across the site on a schedule, chase down why a subscription option isn't showing in the cart, and help us figure out whether a new idea is a quick win or a bigger build.
## Scope of work:
## 1. Know our ecomm stack and help keep it healthy
• Learn how our Shopify store, subscription and cart apps, email and SMS tools, testing tools, tracking and consent setup fit together
• Spot when a change in one tool affects another, and flag app updates or conflicts before they reach customers
• Help run a regular integration and tracking audit
• Document how things work so knowledge is shared across the team
## 2. Build and launch
• Build new sections, templates, product pages, collection pages and landing pages from Figma designs
• Build promo experiences: sale themes, buy boxes, countdowns, and scheduled banner and offer swaps
• Build cart and subscription features, like subscribe-and-save options and upsell and post-purchase modules
• Make sections flexible and reusable so the team can move quickly together
• Run launches end to end: preview, scheduled go-live, rollback plan, post-launch checks
## 3. Lead QA and fixes
• Test every release across devices and browsers, subscription and one-time purchases, discounts and gifts, tracking and page speed
• Build and maintain a QA checklist for our releases
• Triage and fix site bugs, including ones our CX team hears about from customers, and fix the root cause, not just the symptom
## 4. Lead technical discovery
• When the team has a new idea, scope how to build it, what it touches and how long it'll take
• Dig into tricky issues, like apps conflicting or tags firing when they shouldn't, and come back with options and a recommendation
• Bring your own ideas for improving site speed, UX and conversion
5. Keep tracking, consent and site health in good shape
• Keep analytics and pixel events accurate as the site changes
• Make sure tags respect customers' consent choices
• Keep an eye on Core Web Vitals and accessibility
## 6. Keep our workflow clean
• Manage the theme in GitHub, use preview themes for every change, and keep the changelog up to date for every release, so the team always knows what changed, when and why
## What you bring:
• 5+ years building Shopify themes in Liquid, JavaScript and CSS, including Online Store 2.0 sections, blocks and schema
• Experience as the main developer for a DTC brand, owning work from scoping through launch
• Hands-on work with Shopify subscriptions (selling plans and subscription apps) and the Cart AJAX API
• Experience with cart, upsell and post-purchase apps
• Working knowledge of tracking and consent: server-side tracking, GA4/GTM, and consent management platforms
• A QA habit: you test your own work before anyone else sees it, and you write down what you tested
• Shopify CLI and GitHub workflow; you never edit a live theme directly
• Comfort with metafields and metaobjects, Shopify Flow, and app-embed troubleshooting
• An understanding of ecommerce metrics like conversion rate, AOV and subscription retention, and how your work moves them
• Curiosity about how systems connect: you like finding out why something broke, not just patching it
• A collaborative style: you bring a point of view, flag risk early, and say when something will slip
## Nice to have:
• Email and SMS onsite forms and scripts
• A/B testing tools
• Shopify Functions or Checkout Extensibility
• Cloudflare DNS
• Core Web Vitals and accessibility work
• Experience with health, beauty or wellness brands
## Why work with us:
• Real ownership of a site customers use every day, and a say in what we build and how
• A small, collaborative team where people trust each other to make decisions
• An ongoing engagement, not a one-off project
• Fully remote, on your own schedule and your own setup
## Engagement details:
• Independent contract, estimated at 15–20 hours a week on average, with more hours around big launches like Black Friday, agreed in advance
• Remote, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern time

title: Software Engineer (Backend) - Consultations
description:
## The Company
Would you like to create the future of a product used by thousands of businesses and millions of consumers? Phorest Salon Software powers almost 10,000 hair and beauty salons in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Australia, Finland, USA, Canada, UAE and Netherlands, and the platform processes 7 million appointments a month for hair and beauty consumers. Phorest is the number 1 salon software brand for premium independent salons in those markets, and our next goal is to become a platform upon which other companies can build applications for premium salons.
Our system touches every point of the salon experience, from the in-salon appointment calendar and CRM with a fully integrated marketing suite, to staff apps and payments. More recently we have expanded this to include EMR (electronic medical records) for MedSpa clinics.
## The Opportunity
We are looking for a new Software Engineer (Backend) to join our Consultations Team. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product, and design folks in building the future of the hair, beauty, and MedSpa industry. This team looks after the client and patient journey from enquiry, consultation, documentation, and care management. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you will grow your skills in a supportive, growth-mindset environment that will help us achieve our goals.
You will contribute to a high-scale, distributed system, working with event-driven architecture and modern cloud technologies like Docker and Serverless. Your work will impact millions of users globally. You will solve well-defined problems with the guidance of senior engineers and take on more complexity as you grow, in an environment where we continuously improve and learn. We work with feature flags and continuous delivery to get our work to production as fast as possible.
## The type of person we want
Someone who owns their work end to end: accountable for code quality, delivery and operational health, and sees features through development, deployment, monitoring and iteration.
Someone who works with our product designers and owners to turn user stories into shippable features, and contributes to breaking stories down into tasks.
Quality and high standards really matter to us. You will apply good coding techniques including maintainability, reuse, clean code and unit testing, with excellent attention to detail.
Someone who weighs trade-offs in design and performance, and escalates early when requirements or approach are unclear.
Never stops learning: curious, acts on feedback, picks up new tools and practices, and takes a pragmatic approach to solution design.
Someone who is open to code reviews and pairing, and who supports teammates in return.
Someone who takes initiative and is not afraid to ask questions, share ideas and voice an opinion.
Someone who understands how technical decisions affect the user experience and business outcomes.
## What we're looking for
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience
Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn and grow
Strong proficiency and at least 4 years of professional experience building production software with an object-oriented or JVM language, primarily Java or Kotlin
Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs and event-driven services, and an understanding of designing distributed services
Proficiency with or willingness to learn TypeScript/JavaScript, specifically for implementing GraphQL APIs and schema design
Experience with GraphQL would be beneficial but not mandatory
Experience with modern software engineering practices such as Git, continuous delivery, CI/CD pipelines, TDD, and observability tooling
Solid knowledge of relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and query optimisation, and familiarity with NoSQL databases
Experience working in a scrum environment
Great communication: cross-team collaboration is key in our organisation, so we are looking for people who understand others' ideas and explain theirs clearly
## What success looks like
First 3 months: ramp up on the product, work on bugs and small tasks, and pair with and learn from senior team members through code review.
6 months: contribute to breaking stories into tasks, own stories end to end, and be proficient in the product.
12 months: full proficiency in the product, meaningful input into project planning, and ownership of features, potentially delivered end to end.
## Benefits
🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.
💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.
🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.
🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.
🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.
🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.
🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.
Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest.
Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

title: Cloud Engineer (DevOps)
description:
At Aevi, we're not just a team; we're a vibrant, global business, committed to shaking up the payments industry. Our culture is all about innovation, creativity, and a passion for pushing boundaries. We’re thrilled to welcome new Aevi’ators who vibe with our values and mission and are ready to join us on our journey of transformation and growth.
## About the role
As a Cloud Engineer (DevOps), you’ll play a key role in how our payment gateway services are built, delivered and run. You’ll design and operate secure, scalable AWS infrastructure as code, and own the CI/CD pipelines and automation that take our applications from commit to production quickly, safely and repeatably.
Reporting to our Cloud Engineering Team Lead, you’ll work closely with our Development, QA, Operations, Security and Compliance teams. Together, you’ll help our engineers ship with confidence by improving release processes, containerising workloads and building strong monitoring and alerting, using tools such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker and the Grafana LGTM stack.
As we work in the payments industry, this role sits within a secure, tightly regulated environment. It would suit an experienced engineer who values well-defined processes, builds security into every stage of delivery and has a strong eye for detail.
## Key responsibilities
• Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure for our payment gateway services.
• Own the deployment of our payment gateway services to UAT and production, making sure releases are reliable, repeatable and low risk.
• Plan and carry out infrastructure upgrades and migrations, including detailed implementation plans, pre- and post-change validation and rollback strategies.
• Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code in Terraform, promoting reusable modules and consistent standards across environments.
• Build, optimise and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for fast, safe and automated delivery.
• Manage containerised workloads with Docker and ECS/EKS, and champion containerisation best practices across the team.
• Implement and improve monitoring, logging and alerting with the Grafana LGTM stack, giving teams clear visibility of system health and performance.
• Play an active part in incident response, including root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews, to minimise downtime and improve reliability.
• Build security and compliance into our infrastructure and delivery processes, supporting our PCI DSS obligations.
• Coordinate changes with Development, QA, Operations, Security and Compliance, and keep operational processes and runbooks clearly documented.
• Spot opportunities for automation and cost optimisation, and share knowledge and best practices across the engineering team.
## Required skills
• Excellent written and spoken English, at least C1 level.
• Solid experience in Cloud, DevOps or Infrastructure engineering, with substantial hands-on AWS experience in production environments.
• A proven track record of designing, building and operating scalable, highly available and secure cloud infrastructure.
• Strong hands-on skills with core AWS services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Route 53 and ALB/NLB, and a solid understanding of AWS networking, security best practices and multi-account setups.
• Advanced Terraform skills, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces and multi-environment code structures.
• Strong experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines, including reusable workflows, environments, secrets management and authentication to AWS.
• Good Docker skills, including building optimised, secure images and managing container registries such as ECR.
• Experience implementing monitoring and logging, ideally with the Grafana LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir).
• Confidence with Git and GitHub, including branching strategies, pull request workflows and code reviews.
• Good knowledge of TCP/IP networking, including addressing, routing, services, IPsec and VPNs.
• Hands-on experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and DynamoDB.
• Experience working in agile engineering teams, collaborating closely with developers, QA and security.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to build good working relationships with business and product teams, internal stakeholders and customers.
• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
## It would be a plus if you bring
• Experience in a regulated environment such as payments or financial services, with exposure to standards like PCI DSS.
• AWS certifications, for example Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer.
• Experience with cost optimisation and FinOps practices on AWS.
• Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, support decision-making or drive innovation.
• Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence).
## Location and travel
• This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the Philippines or Malaysia, working in the local time zone (GMT+8).
• You’ll need to be available for occasional weekend and out-of-hours support for critical production incidents.
## Life at Aevi
Being part of Aevi? Flexibility, honesty, development, and support are the essentials of our work environment, and we live for a “work smarter, not harder” mindset. At Aevi, we celebrate diversity and inclusivity, firmly believing that our strength lies in our individuality. Our commitment to a better working culture is reflected in our respect and appreciation for each team member, cheering on everyone to just be themselves at work and outside.
## What's in it for you?
- Be part of a dynamic, fun-loving team that values teamwork and flexibility.
- Benefit from our unlimited vacation policy, so you can take a breather whenever you want and need it.
- Quickly become a key player of our motivated, energetic, and global team.
- Thrive in a culture that lets your unique work style shine.
## Who are Aevi:
Our mission is to build a more open world, where anyone, anywhere, can take or make any kind of payment.
Our cloud-based platform lets payments and transaction data flow across all channels and consumer touchpoints. By connecting digital and in-person interfaces, we are committed to creating the best possible customer experience at the point-of-interaction. Today, we operate across Europe, Australia, and the US with offices in London, Prague, and Paderborn.
## Our Vision and Support:
We are setting payments free!
Supported by visionary shareholders in the industry like Mastercardand HPE Growth Capital, we stand at the forefront of payment innovation, surrounded by like-minded partners who share our vision for a seamless payment future.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
## Who are Tyk, and what do we do?
The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services.Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)
If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London – UK, London – Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.
## Our Mission
Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.
## Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility
We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.
If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.
## The role:
We’re looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to manage, maintain, improve and provide support on our platform. You will be curious by nature, always looking for ways to improve, as we will look to you for new ideas, solutions and metrics on how we can improve the platform. You will also be our first line of incident management to our clients and will help define our response going forward. This is a great opportunity to become an integral part of Tyk as we continue on our journey.
As a remote first company, you will have the opportunity to work with an industry leading distributed team. Having access to expertise from across the globe will give you both the support and opportunity to help shape not only Tyk’s Cloud platform but also the Tyk as a whole as we continue to grow.
## Requirements
## Here’s what you’ll be responsible for:
• Maintaining global Tyk Cloud within SL(A/I/O)s you will help to define
• Identifying reliability issues and working together with your squad to solve them
• Identifying and introducing new metrics and building relevant dashboards
• Participating in the on-call rotation
• Working with your squad to expand multi-region and multi-cloud reach of the platform
• Documenting operational knowledge
• Conducting post-incident analysis
• Automating common tasks
• Be a key shaper and contributor to our continuous improvement agenda – be it the clarity of our user stories, how we estimate, communicate with other teams or customers – we expect this role to be advocate of continuous improvement
• Reliability of our new global Tyk Cloud platform
• Automation of operations and support
• Writing and maintaining documentation on SRE processes and policies
• Recommending and implementing ways of driving operational efficiency and driving down our cost to run, without impacting service
• Assisting in penetration testing for Cloud through liaising with our provider, providing technical details, and environment setup
• Incident management
## Here’s what we’re looking for:
Experience
• Strong collaboration skills
• Launching and operating production scale kubernetes clusters
• Designing and operating infrastructure on AWS and other providers
• Operating MongoDB (or other document database) clusters
• Operating Redis (or other key-value storage) clusters
• Administering Linux servers
• Maintaining distributed software
• Operating Prometheus and Grafana
• Operating logging collection and analysis systems
• Participating in the on-call rotation(16:00pm – 4:00am UTC)
## Skills:
• Kubernetes & containers (advanced)
• AWS / EKS (advanced)
• Linux (advanced)
• Go (proficient)
• Terraform and IaC in general (proficient)
• Helm (proficient)
• MongoDB (or similar)
• Redis (or similar)
• Monitoring – prometheus, grafana, thanos (familiar)
• Grasp of networking concepts (subnets, routing, peering, load balancing, NAT, etc.)
• Common networking protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, UDP)
• Proactive, energetic, innovative and change oriented
## Nice to have:
• GCP or Azure
• Bare metal infrastructure engineering
• API management experience
• Large scale distributed storage management
• Familiarity with Rancher
• CKA/CKAD/CKS
• Creating and delivering production software in Go language
## Benefits
## Here’s why you should join us:
• Everyone has unlimited paid holiday.
• We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
• Employee share scheme
• Generous maternity and paternity leave
• Company retreats
We all share the same vision – we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? – to make what we do even better!
## Our values tell the story of Tyk – here’s how:
• It’s ok to screw up!
We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones – so try it, at least we can say we have!
• The only stupid idea, is the untested one!
It’s in our DNA – starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free – sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!
• Trust starts with you – make it count!
Trust is a two-way street – instill it from day one!
• Assume best intent!
We have each other’s back – we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.
• Make things, better!
Always try to leave things better than when you found them – change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

title: Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control
description:
The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control, who will develop C++ control software for the robot arm, from single-motor to multi-body control. 

Responsibilities

  • Control Software: Design and develop C++ software for the robot's control stack, covering kinematics, trajectory generation, and compliance control from single-motor to multi-body coordination.
  • Hardware Tuning: Support parameter identification and controller-gain tuning against physical hardware, working alongside more senior engineers to close the gap between simulation and real behavior.
  • Real-Time Performance: Profile control software and help keep it within the timing margins the arm's safety and stability depend on.
  • Hardware Validation: Write automated software tests, define hardware testing procedures, and work hands-on with the robot to confirm control software behaves correctly outside simulation.
  • Code Quality: Take part in code reviews with the wider team, both giving and receiving feedback that keeps the control codebase maintainable.
  • Technology Evaluation: Investigate and evaluate emerging robotic control methods and algorithms relevant to the team's work.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in computer science, control engineering, mechatronics, or a related engineering field, with one to three years of professional experience in C++ development, or an equivalent record of relevant academic or project work.
  • Kinematics & Dynamics: Working understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics, sufficient to reason about forward and inverse mappings and trajectory generation for a multi-body arm.
  • Control Engineering: Background in control engineering, with some exposure to parameter identification and controller tuning.
  • Modern C++: Working proficiency in modern C++, including thread-safe and exception-safe code, and comfort working across the standard build, test, and debugging toolchain on Linux.
  • Hardware Troubleshooting: Basic ability and willingness to troubleshoot and debug directly on physical robotic hardware, not only software running in isolation.

Beneficial Skills

  • Python: Working programming skills in Python or a similar scripting language, used alongside C++ for tooling and analysis.
  • CI/CD Ownership: Experience maintaining or extending CI/CD pipelines for a C++ codebase.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.
